docs.title: (Q)EAA Provider Sign/Seal Certificate
docs.text:
The specific requirements for 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:45be90d32940d39cf2485d61843e0910: and 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:92879173acdfa6849f6a3eb9e754d5fc: Sign/Seal Certificates are specified in Clauses 6 and 7 of [ETSI TS 119 412-6], respectively.

The following table defines the complete set of extensions applicable to the certificate profile. Extensions not listed in the table SHALL NOT be present.

Extension Presence Notes authorityKeyIdentifier REQUIRED The value of the keyIdentifier field SHOULD be derived from the public key using the methods defined in [RFC 5280, Section 4.2.1.1] subjectKeyIdentifier OPTIONAL If present, its value SHOULD be derived from the subject public key using the methods defined in [RFC 5280, Section 4.2.1.2]. keyUsage REQUIRED It SHALL contain one (and only one) of the key-usage settings Type A, Type B, Type C, or Type F. certificatePolicies REQUIRED (only for QEAA) As described in [ETSI EN 319 411-2, Clause 6.6.1]. subjectAltName REQUIRED cRLDistributionPoints CONDITIONAL REQUIRED IF: the certificate does not include any access location of an 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:1ad6ec3456391c3330f2d5d1b615b991: responder or the validity assured extension as defined in [ETSI EN 319 412-1]. If present, it SHALL contain at least one reference to a publicly available 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:e07d7b4904e4e4c79439b2ded80c560d:. authorityInfoAccess REQUIRED (only for QEAA) It SHALL include an AccessDescription structure with accessMethod set to 1.3.6.1.5.5.7.48.2 (id-ad-caIssuers) and accessLocation specifying at least one access location of a valid CA certificate of the issuing 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:76aaeed0264f9c973a9794fdd0af5d63:. If 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:4feeffd36029979a30899a55dfac8ecc: is supported by the issuing 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:edfdfe8bb8b62079e11e1bbe56103d32:, the extension SHALL include an AccessDescription structure with accessMethod set to 1.3.6.1.5.5.7.48.1 (id-ad-ocsp) and accessLocation specifying at least one 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:8e5acd09b2980a3876a49612175630ec: responder authoritative to provide certificate status information for the certificate, as described in Online Certificate Status Protocol. qcStatements REQUIRED (QEAA), OPTIONAL (EAA) For 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:3f38f33fe4827ca4e28382a8dac9f533:: It SHALL contain a QCStatement structure with statementId set to 0.4.0.1862.1.1 (id-etsi-qcs-QcCompliance), referred to as esi4-qcStatement-1.For 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:fc1471f3dce09e93e9c818a3dd1a7268::
  • It SHALL NOT contain a QCStatement structure with statementId set to 0.4.0.1862.1.1 (id-etsi-qcs-QcCompliance), referred to as esi4-qcStatement-1.
  • It SHALL NOT contain a QCStatement structure with statementId set to 0.4.0.1862.1.4 (id-etsi-qcs-QcSSCD), referred to as esi4-qcStatement-4.
For both:
  • It MAY contain additional QCStatement structures among those defined in [ETSI EN 319 412-5, Clause 4.2].
  • In any case, it SHALL NOT contain a QCStatement structure with statementId set to 0.4.0.1862.1.7 (id-etsi-qcs-QcCClegislation), referred to as esi4-qcStatement-7.

APTITUDE Implementation Choices

  • 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:0ade45e10a7bf46d7d1224b52feddd56: Sign/Seal Certificates SHALL be Qualified Certificates. Therefore, the qcStatements extension SHALL contain at least a QCStatement structure with statementId set to 0.4.0.1862.1.1 (id-etsi-qcs-QcCompliance).

  • 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:6c26e26bbc158559d2cc01f1ec3fee8c: Sign/Seal Certificates SHALL NOT be Qualified Certificates. Therefore, the qcStatements extension SHALL NOT contain QCStatement structures with statementId set to 0.4.0.1862.1.1 (id-etsi-qcs-QcCompliance) or 0.4.0.1862.1.4 (id-etsi-qcs-QcSSCD). Example: QEAA Provider Sign/Seal Certificate 

    AccessCertificate cert = {
  tbsCertificate: {
    version: 2,                                           // Integer value 2 for v3
    serialNumber: "0x7364DE67A6...",

    signature: AlgorithmIdentifier {
      oid: "1.2.840.113549.1.1.11",                       // sha256WithRSAEncryption
      params: NULL
    },

    issuer: DistinguishedName {
      countryName: "CZ",
      organizationName: "Example Trust Services CA",
      commonName: "Example CA",
      organizationIdentifier: "VATCZ-123456789"
    },

    validity: {
      notBefore: Time.utcTime("260127000000Z"),
      notAfter: Time.utcTime("270127000000Z")
    },

    subject: DistinguishedName {
      countryName: "CZ",
      organizationName: "Example of QEAA Provider",
      commonName: "QEAA Provider Example",
      organizationIdentifier: "LEIXG-5494001KJTIIGC8Y1R56"
    },

    subjectPublicKeyInfo: {
      algorithm: AlgorithmIdentifier {
        oid: "1.2.840.113549.1.1.1",                      // rsaEncryption
        params: NULL
      },

      subjectPublicKey: "BASE64(SPKI_PUBLIC_KEY_BYTES)"
    },

    extensions: [
      Extension {
        oid: "2.5.29.35",                                 // authorityKeyIdentifier
        critical: false,
        value: AuthorityKeyIdentifier {
          keyIdentifier: "SHA-1(ISSUER_PUBLIC_KEY_VALUE)"
        }
      },

      Extension {
        oid: "2.5.29.15",                                 // keyUsage
        critical: true,
        value: KeyUsage {
          nonRepudiation: true                            // Type A
          // All other bits set to false
        }
      },

      Extension {
        oid: "2.5.29.32",                                 // certificatePolicies
        critical: false,
        value: CertificatePolicies [
          PolicyInformation {
            policyIdentifier: "0.4.0.194112.1.3",         // qcp-legal-qscd
            policyQualifiers: [
              CPSuri("https://rpca.example.test/cps")
            ]
          }
        ]
      },

      Extension {
        oid: "2.5.29.17",                                 // subjectAltName
        critical: false,
        value: SubjectAltName [
          GeneralName.uniformResourceIdentifier("https://eaa.example.test/support"),
          GeneralName.rfc822Name("support@eaa.example.test"),
          GeneralName.otherName(
            type-id: "2.5.4.20",                          // id-at-telephoneNumber
            value: "+420111222555"
          )
        ]
      },

      Extension {
        oid: "2.5.29.31",                                 // cRLDistributionPoints
        critical: false,
        value: CRLDistributionPoints [
          DistributionPoint {
            distributionPoint: DistributionPointName.fullName([
              GeneralName.uniformResourceIdentifier("http://crl.example.test/issuing-ca.crl")
            ])
          }
        ]
      },

      Extension {
        oid: "1.3.6.1.5.5.7.1.1",                         // authorityInfoAccess
        critical: false,
        value: AuthorityInfoAccess [
          AccessDescription {
            accessMethod: "1.3.6.1.5.5.7.48.2",           // id-ad-caIssuers
            accessLocation: GeneralName.uniformResourceIdentifier("http://ca.example.test/caIssuers/issuing-ca.cer")
          },

          AccessDescription {
            accessMethod: "1.3.6.1.5.5.7.48.1",           // id-ad-ocsp
            accessLocation: GeneralName.uniformResourceIdentifier("http://ocsp.example.test")
          }
        ]
      },

      Extension {
        oid: "1.3.6.1.5.5.7.1.3",                         // qcStatements
        critical: false,
        value: QCStatements [
          QCStatement {                                   // esi4-qcStatement-1
            statementId: "0.4.0.1862.1.1",                // id-etsi-qcs-QcCompliance
          },

          QCStatement {                                   // esi4-qcStatement-4
            statementId: "0.4.0.1862.1.4",                // id-etsi-qcs-QcSSCD
          },

          QCStatement {
            statementId: "0.4.0.1862.1.6",                // id-etsi-qcs-QcType
            statementInfo: QcType [
              "0.4.0.1862.1.6.1"                          // id-etsi-qct-esign
            ]
          }
        ]
      }
    ]
  },

  signatureAlgorithm: AlgorithmIdentifier {
    oid: "1.2.840.113549.1.1.11",                         // SHALL match/align with tbsCertificate.signature
    params: NULL
  },

  signatureValue: "BASE64(SIGN(issuerPrivateKey, DER(tbsCertificate)))"
}

docs.title: PuB-EAA Provider Sign/Seal Certificate
docs.text:
The following table defines the complete set of extensions applicable to the certificate profile. Extensions not listed in the table SHALL NOT be present.

Extension Presence Notes authorityKeyIdentifier REQUIRED The value of the keyIdentifier field SHOULD be derived from the public key using the methods defined in [RFC 5280, Section 4.2.1.1] subjectKeyIdentifier OPTIONAL If present, its value be derived from the subject public key using the methods defined in [RFC 5280, Section 4.2.1.2]. keyUsage REQUIRED certificatePolicies REQUIRED As described in [ETSI EN 319 411-2, Clause 6.6.1]. subjectAltName REQUIRED cRLDistributionPoints CONDITIONAL REQUIRED IF: the certificate does not include any access location of an 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:a05b6e7b630e8cbf7c397b8e87633bc2: responder or the validity assured extension as defined in [ETSI EN 319 412-1]. If present, it SHALL contain at least one reference to a publicly available 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:54eb17f5672f1316ebe37b6636d026e6:. authorityInfoAccess REQUIRED It SHALL include an AccessDescription structure with accessMethod set to 1.3.6.1.5.5.7.48.2 (id-ad-caIssuers) and accessLocation specifying at least one access location of a valid CA certificate of the issuing 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:543b1fa82fcdef83fdf203e8e456a332:. If 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:cb483dca3296c087019796e11828a7b9: is supported by the issuing 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:0f7accae72d32d8d16ddd603c7056daa:, the extension SHALL include an AccessDescription structure with accessMethod set to 1.3.6.1.5.5.7.48.1 (id-ad-ocsp) and accessLocation specifying at least one 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:8ed3bc57f17ec3b49a1174b567c5fb34: responder authoritative to provide certificate status information for the certificate, as described in Online Certificate Status Protocol. qcStatements REQUIRED It SHALL contain:
  • A QCStatement structure with statementId set to 0.4.0.1862.1.1 (id-etsi-qcs-QcCompliance), referred to as esi4-qcStatement-1.
  • A QCStatement structure with statementId set to the OID corresponding to id-etsi-qcs-QcPSB; the corresponding statementInfo SHALL contain a QcPSB structure including the fields defined in [ETSI TS 119 412-6, Clause 8.3].
It MAY contain additional QCStatement structures among those defined in [ETSI EN 319 412-5, Clause 4.2]. In any case, it SHALL NOT contain a QCStatement structure with statementId set to 0.4.0.1862.1.7 (id-etsi-qcs-QcCClegislation), referred to as esi4-qcStatement-7.

Warning

While the specific requirements for 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:57159d7966cc280c653bab28976fb608: Sign/Seal Certificates specified in [ETSI TS 119 412-6, Clause 8] do not require these certificates to be qualified, [EU REG 2024/1183, Art. 45f(1)(b)] requires 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:bcdbec15a64ef675e6f2de755195e243: to be signed with a qualified certificate.

APTITUDE Implementation Choice

To comply with [EU REG 2024/1183, Art. 45f(1)(b)], although not explicitly required by [ARF] or [ETSI TS 119 412-6], 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:140462441afb2fb8305438c63542cca6: Sign/Seal Certificates are Qualified Certificates. Therefore, the qcStatements extension SHALL contain at least a QCStatement structure with statementId set to 0.4.0.1862.1.1 (id-etsi-qcs-QcCompliance).

Warning

[ETSI TS 119 412-6, Annex A] does not define the specific OID of the id-etsi-qcs-QcPSB statement identifier.

Example: Pub-EAA Provider Sign/Seal Certificate 

AccessCertificate cert = {
  tbsCertificate: {
    version: 2,                                           // Integer value 2 for v3
    serialNumber: "0x6354A56B5D...",

    signature: AlgorithmIdentifier {
      oid: "1.2.840.113549.1.1.11",                       // sha256WithRSAEncryption
      params: NULL
    },

    issuer: DistinguishedName {
      countryName: "IT",
      organizationName: "Example Trust Services CA",
      commonName: "Example CA",
      organizationIdentifier: "VATIT-123456789"
    },

    validity: {
      notBefore: Time.utcTime("260127000000Z"),
      notAfter: Time.utcTime("270127000000Z")
    },

    subject: DistinguishedName {
      countryName: "IT",
      organizationName: "Example of PuB-EAA Provider",
      commonName: "PuB-EAA Provider Example",
      organizationIdentifier: "LEIXG-5494201KJTIIGC8Y1R12"
    },

    subjectPublicKeyInfo: {
      algorithm: AlgorithmIdentifier {
        oid: "1.2.840.113549.1.1.1",                      // rsaEncryption
        params: NULL
      },

      subjectPublicKey: "BASE64(SPKI_PUBLIC_KEY_BYTES)"
    },

    extensions: [
      Extension {
        oid: "2.5.29.35",                                 // authorityKeyIdentifier
        critical: false,
        value: AuthorityKeyIdentifier {
          keyIdentifier: "SHA-1(ISSUER_PUBLIC_KEY_VALUE)"
        }
      },

      Extension {
        oid: "2.5.29.14",                                 // subjectKeyIdentifier
        critical: false,
        value: SubjectKeyIdentifier("SHA-1(SUBJECT_PUBLIC_KEY_VALUE)")
      },

      Extension {
        oid: "2.5.29.15",                                 // keyUsage
        critical: true,
        value: KeyUsage {
          nonRepudiation: true                            // Type A
          // All other bits set to false
        }
      },

      Extension {
        oid: "2.5.29.32",                                 // certificatePolicies
        critical: false,
        value: CertificatePolicies [
          PolicyInformation {
            policyIdentifier: "0.4.0.194112.1.3",         // qcp-legal-qscd
            policyQualifiers: [
              CPSuri("https://rpca.example.test/cps")
            ]
          }
        ]
      },

      Extension {
        oid: "2.5.29.17",                                 // subjectAltName
        critical: false,
        value: SubjectAltName [
          GeneralName.uniformResourceIdentifier("https://pub-eaa.example.test/support"),
          GeneralName.rfc822Name("support@pub-eaa.example.test"),
          GeneralName.otherName(
            type-id: "2.5.4.20",                          // id-at-telephoneNumber
            value: "+420111222777"
          )
        ]
      },

      Extension {
        oid: "2.5.29.31",                                 // cRLDistributionPoints
        critical: false,
        value: CRLDistributionPoints [
          DistributionPoint {
            distributionPoint: DistributionPointName.fullName([
              GeneralName.uniformResourceIdentifier("http://crl.example.test/issuing-ca.crl")
            ])
          }
        ]
      },

      Extension {
        oid: "1.3.6.1.5.5.7.1.1",                         // authorityInfoAccess
        critical: false,
        value: AuthorityInfoAccess [
          AccessDescription {
            accessMethod: "1.3.6.1.5.5.7.48.2",           // id-ad-caIssuers
            accessLocation: GeneralName.uniformResourceIdentifier("http://ca.example.test/caIssuers/issuing-ca.cer")
          },

          AccessDescription {
            accessMethod: "1.3.6.1.5.5.7.48.1",           // id-ad-ocsp

      },

docs.title: Ocsp artifacts
docs.text: The 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:be2727ad60002b16b3be71e08312af29:<__None__> enables applications to determine the revocation status of identified certificates. This section specifies the structure of 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:0946e821fee8ba0f1a876ffb67ef7a60:<__None__> Requests and Responses. The operational use of 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:5fc0a979a502e3f111f1ed8023f452f2:<__None__> within the APTITUDE ecosystem is detailed in Online Certificate Status Protocol.

docs.title: OCSP Request
docs.text:
In accordance with [RFC 6960, Section 4.1], the OCSPRequest ASN.1 structure consists of a SEQUENCE composed of the following fields:

Field Type Presence Description Reference in [RFC 6960] tbsRequest SEQUENCE REQUIRED Contains the optionally signed 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:0039f39b480cc7a3116330da5b85be45:<__None__> request. Section 4.1.1 optionalSignature SEQUENCE OPTIONAL Contains the identifier for the cryptographic algorithm used to sign the request (if applicable). Section 4.1.1

Note

The rest of the section details the content of the tbsRequest field only. For additional information on the optionalSignature field, refer to [RFC 6960].

The tbsRequest field SHALL contain a TBSRequest structure conforming to [RFC 6960, Section 4.1.1]. The following table details the supported fields, including presence requirements, syntax types, descriptions, and corresponding references in [RFC 6960].

Field Type Presence Description Reference in [RFC 6960] version INTEGER OPTIONAL Describes the version of the protocol. If omitted, it defaults to version 1 (value 0). Section 4.1.1 requestList SEQUENCE REQUIRED Contains a sequence of one or more certificate status requests. Section 4.1.1 requestExtensions SEQUENCE OPTIONAL Contains a sequence of one or more extensions applicable to the requests. The applicable extensions are defined below. Section 4.1.1

The following table specifies the extensions supported by this specification, including their Object Identifiers (OIDs), type, presence requirement, description, and normative references.

Extension OID Type Presence Description Reference nonce 1.3.6.1.5.5.7.48.1.2 OCTET STRING REQUIRED Represents a cryptographically fresh value used to bind a request and a response to prevent replay attacks. [RFC 6960, Section 4.4.1] Example: OCSP Request 

OCSPRequest:
  tbsRequest:
    version = v1
    requestList = SEQUENCE OF
      Request:
        reqCert:
          hashAlgorithm:
            algorithm  = sha256
            parameters = null
          issuerNameHash = SHA256( DER-encode(Issuer Name) )
          issuerKeyHash  = SHA256( Issuer SubjectPublicKey BIT STRING )
          serialNumber   = 0x01A2B3C4D5
    requestExtensions:
      nonce = OCTET STRING (nonce)

docs.title: OCSP Response
docs.text:
In accordance with [RFC 6960, Section 4.2], the OCSPResponse ASN.1 structure consists of a SEQUENCE composed of the following fields:

Field Type Presence Description Reference in [RFC 6960] responseStatus ENUMERATED REQUIRED Indicates the processing status of the prior request. The following values are supported: successful (0), malformedRequest (1), internalError (2), tryLater (3), sigRequired (5), unauthorized (6). Section 4.2.1 responseBytes SEQUENCE OPTIONAL Contains the response type and the encoded response data. It SHALL be specified only in case responseStatus indicates the successful status. Section 4.2.1

APTITUDE Implementation Choices

  • The response structure represented by the responseBytes field SHALL contain the nonce extension among the responseExtensions.
  • 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:15e7714b184c4bb196a399aae059dfa9: responders SHALL be capable of producing responses of the id-pkix-ocsp-basic response type. Correspondingly, 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:7c5b971462d9fef34e89286f29ef8ef5: clients SHALL be capable of receiving and processing responses of the id-pkix-ocsp-basic response type. Example: OCSP Response 

    OCSPResponse:
  responseStatus = successful (0)
  responseBytes:
    responseType = id-pkix-ocsp-basic
    response = DER(BasicOCSPResponse)
      BasicOCSPResponse: 
        tbsResponseData:
          version = v1
          responderID"
            byName: 
             CN = Example OCSP Responder
             O  = Example CA
             C  = CZ
          producedAt = 20250101000000Z
          responses = SEQUENCE OF
            SingleResponse:
              certID:
                hashAlgorithm  = sha1
                issuerNameHash = SHA1( DER-encode(issuer Name) )
                issuerKeyHash  = SHA1( issuer SubjectPublicKey BIT STRING )
                serialNumber   = 0x01A2B3C4D5
              certStatus  = good
              thisUpdate  = 20250101000000Z
              nextUpdate  = 20250102000000Z
              singleExtensions = absent
          responseExtensions:
            nonce = OCTET STRING (nonce)
        signatureAlgorithm = sha256WithRSAEncryption
        signature          = BIT STRING (signature over hash(DER(tbsResponseData)))
        certs              = SEQUENCE OF
            Certificate (responder’s cert, possibly with its issuing CA cert)

docs.title: Onboarding process
docs.text:
This section describes the Onboarding Process within APTITUDE, where it is realised as the mocked-up version of the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:b732003b964805e1148368ddbd49f4cb: Registration Process and 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:3256c055501f027af0bbd7bb5fd8667c: (defined in Trust Architecture) through which entities become operational and recognisable in the common trust infrastructure of the pilot.

Onboarding collects all the information needed to make entities operational and recognisable, and it replaces the administrative and regulatory processes that, outside the pilot, manage the registration, 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:b05277f45317954be028fb8617dfa69e: and publication of 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:4b0373d39a46a5c79f201411dea3c566: between Member States and the European Commission.

Within the pilot, consistently with Trust Architecture, not all onboarding processes are implemented as defined in the [ARF] and related specifications:

  • The elements which follows the specifications are: the creation of the registration records, the certificates issuance and the respective profiles, and the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:538fdbfd19f89177ecd14a46162cf547: publication which enable the distribution of the trust artifacts which enable trust evaluation.
  • The elements which differ according to the constraints highlighted in the Introduction are: the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:a763f13bd62d790ece3e69d89403c67e: process between a Member State and the European Commission, the publication of the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:889f769f0e77e792158d65425b2fce54: signing certificate in the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:e21f669003357ade1cc77eebcea05dd5:<__None__>, and the registration of entities with the prescribed regulatory checks.

    Note

    The certification of technical products such as a 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:e06f746299b0e25824bbd4298f93a812:<__None__> is out of scope of the pilot: it is an external process, and only its outcome is referenced. The data schemas, certificate profiles, 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:b4a38793c8470dc6cc71af21c817acf4: formats, and low-level protocols are instead out of scope of this section only: they are normatively defined in the referenced sections of this specification and are only pointed to from here.

    This boundary is mapped onto the components of the Onboarding System in the summary table at the end of Onboarding System.

    APTITUDE Implementation Choice

    Requirements specific to the APTITUDE ecosystem are identified inline with the prefix [ONBOARD-...] and consolidated in Onboarding Requirements. Obligations defined in other sections of this specification, or in the normative baseline, are referenced where they apply, keeping their own identifiers.

    The APTITUDE Onboarding System SHALL implement the Onboarding Process defined in this section [ONBOARD-GEN-01].

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
The entities involved in onboarding fall into two categories, and this distinction underpins the whole process:

  • Trust infrastructure entities (in short, infrastructure entities) are the entities that operate the trust infrastructure through which onboarding is performed, namely registration, certificate issuance (the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:0d276ae24abc047cc6004807cc406bc5:, the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:6fc6580264d0aa79bdee362373572fb3:, and the Provider of Sign/Seal Certificates), and publication of the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:59d9901e8f2ad630ed3fb6ec3b8ed961:<__None__> (the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:4f33f457c4c7a48f43036a52c191aa43:). The 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:24da588ea1e211a86b105ba02a302e9f: has its LoTE signing certificate referenced in the Official Journal of Aptitude.
  • Operational entities are the entities that are onboarded through that infrastructure in order to become operational and recognisable in the ecosystem, namely the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:c0d01971a84a6e3be3cdeddce41a46f4: and the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:da2df52cb4d1faead52a75019921b268:.

    The onboarding process presupposes the existence of a functional trust infrastructure. Its one-time setup is a prerequisite that SHALL be satisfied before any operational entity can be onboarded; it is described in Trust Infrastructure Prerequisites. The recurring process through which operational entities become active is described in Operational Entity Onboarding.

docs.title: Trust Infrastructure Prerequisites
docs.text:
The Onboarding System operates on top of a trust infrastructure whose entities SHALL be established and have their 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:22ab72ea0d34765ea2aa02217193fbee: published before any operational entity can be onboarded. This setup is a one-time prerequisite and is not part of the recurring onboarding flow; operational entity onboarding SHALL NOT start before it is in place [ONBOARD-GEN-02].

Within APTITUDE, the trust infrastructure prerequisites SHALL be established out of band and require no pilot software [ONBOARD-PRE-01]. The 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:38aa6acdfc6ab6869d66170b626b0050: of the infrastructure entities are provided and shared among the participants as a one-time operational setup. What is implemented and testable is the result, i.e. the signed, published 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:e6e1920083597c850e7fa695a115a6a0: against which trust is later evaluated (see Trust Anchor Validation Process). The operations below describe the trust infrastructure setup process.

    OJA(["OJA root<br/>(LoTE Provider root certificate)"])

    subgraph LoTE["Infrastructure LoTE"]
        L1[("LoTE with Registrars TA")]
        L2[("LoTE with Providers of WRPAC TA")]

The setup comprises the following operations:

  1. Key and Certificate Provisioning. Each trust infrastructure entity provides its signing key and certificate. Within APTITUDE, the trust infrastructure signing entities MAY use self-signed root certificates with no higher certification authority or CA certificates with self managed PKI. Regardless of the choice, Trust in the certificate is conferred by the publication as a 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:773d6a2ca4f3ff70d79716ae30c3e492:<__None__> in the relevant 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:c06dcbacf00eb413f185b250a6bb24a7: and SHALL be treated as a Trusted input in any pilot use case.
  2. LoTE Signing Certificates. The signing certificates of the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:d19bd6d2e5f541e1eb056febc144d733: are used to validate the lists. Within APTITUDE, the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:78b715c4a8e312a6c6ec631060648239: publication is and distribution point where this artifact is made available to the APTITUDE Partners is an operational matter, out of scope of this document.
  3. Notification of Trust Anchors. The 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:cb253f592726ff3d8b48c636bc519c39:<__None__> of each infrastructure entity is listed in its corresponding 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:a6fb9c362051089f98c666639b9cd910: as described in the above picture.
  4. Signing and Publication. The 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:864c2fc6fdde9952f6fda39c0ede561b: signs/seals the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:2a8ae8b46fb3796a9b1c01b5da1d06d7: and publishes them at a distribution point referenced by the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:72b47da332a3a0ccf061c8d745b2a335:, so that they can be retrieved at validation time (see Trust Anchor Validation Process).

docs.title: Operational Entity Onboarding
docs.text: This section describes the recurring process through which operational entities become active in the ecosystem, once the Trust Infrastructure Prerequisites are in place (ONBOARD-GEN-02).

docs.title: Onboarding System
docs.text:
This section describes the logical components that implement the Onboarding Process in APTITUDE and how they relate. It is an APTITUDE-specific logical view as the roles are normatively defined, but their decomposition into components is a pilot design choice and is not defined by the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:09ba066c2f51b884641c2c8324214b36:<__None__> normative framework. Technical implementation details (technologies, protocols, deployment) are out of scope of this document. The diagram below shows how the operational entity requesting onboarding interacts with these components.

graph TB

    OpEn(["Operational Entity (requesting onboarding)"])

    subgraph SYS["APTITUDE Onboarding System - components"]
        direction LR
        UI["Onboarding UI"]
        RegSvc["Registration Service<br/>verification, record and status management (+ REST API)"]
        WRPReg[("WRP Register<br/>CIR 2025/848 records")]
        ACsvc["WRPAC Issuance Service<br/>issue / revoke WRPAC"]
        RCsvc["WRPRC Issuance Service<br/>issue / revoke WRPRC"]
        SSCsvc["Sign/Seal Certificate Issuance Service<br/>issue / revoke Sign/Seal Certificates"]
        PubSvc["Publication Service<br/>(mocked EC / MS-TLP)<br/>consolidate and publish"]
        NotifDS[("Notification dataset<br/>CIR 2024/2980 notifiable info")]
        Lists[("LoTE")]

        UI -->|"create / check / update registration"| RegSvc
        UI -->|"request WRPAC"| ACsvc
        UI -.->|"request WRPRC (where applicable)"| RCsvc

    end

    OpEn <-->|"submit data, receive the resulting artifacts and check status"| UI

The components, and the role each realises, are:

  • Onboarding UI (APTITUDE-specific orchestrator). It is the single point of contact of the entities requesting onboarding and coordinates the other services. It collects the data submitted by the entity, and it SHALL trigger, in order, registration, certificate issuance, and, where applicable, publication or update of the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:dc8b0c615740f5833cb59c5fe2e6d5a6: entry [ONBOARD-GEN-03].
  • Registration Service. It implements the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:25927344d0e5a9af32bf33576bf28153:<__None__> role, handling verification and the management of the registration record and its status. It exposes the common REST API (see Common Register API).
  • 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:4eacd36830c8ab98d288935c631bb7e3: Register. It is the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:66fab345e939fe92b9d4c0750920368e:<__None__> defined by [CIR 2025/848], which stores the registration records.
  • 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:fb936ee0fbe327e43f6185ce9091bcb0: Issuance Service and 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:ca1003f61eb52691d6c05d012aaacfe0: Issuance Service. They realise the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:12d7e51298a04742477044d8c51cba00: and the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:1db485ee31b9fa92e5f56ec796438c31:.
  • Sign/Seal Certificate Issuance Service. It realise the Sign/Seal Certificate Provider role which issues certificates to sign 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:edeb72165fe548421580566ad11a655d:, 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:6ac3c4ad4862ab4251542362169dfb8c: and 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:388751fbeec78ec897caa681e3ad0f71:.
  • Publication Service. It realises the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:5f191419b98716fd47a032c244b193af: that signs and publishes the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:37d8339114a656127fe64d2f5c56c10d:.

    Note

    Within the APTITUDE ecosystem, the Onboarding UI is an abstract orchestrator, and it could be implemented as a structured intake (for example a web form or a portal) that drives the services. The specific user interface is an implementation matter.

    The Onboarding System SHALL keep the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:a26ac8a5ab2f3c975fd009fc43d3c5c1: and the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:40545fe48e6829c0b39a28c6c17a9f62:<__None__> dataset as two distinct data stores [ONBOARD-GEN-04], because the data needed for notification does not fully coincide with the data that populates the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:5681dff7de97a58fdf979827652c982d::

    • the WRP Register holds the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:7c835665c1da0c967438df9b3ea49248: registration records ([CIR 2025/848]), namely identification, intended use, and related data, as defined in Register Data Schema;
    • the Notification dataset holds the notifiable information related to the notifiable entity ([CIR 2024/2980]), namely identification, 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:3e478bc26e62048b0510006ab6772396:, and service supply points, whose fields are defined as 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:48778787bd402243e96ec2e260dd75de: entries in List of Trusted Entities.

      Note

      The datasets above overlap only in part (i.e., they possess common identification data).

      Note

      Notice that some infrastructure entities that are notified but not registered as 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:dfe1f6e9cf1ae1b3cb990d138322cb82: (6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:b0330a061ac6282cf2db136b8b50a6d4:, 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:a58b9b49ad7c02f88708fea0e859de64:, 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:bcc85dfbb2f36cfbb9ce01d93db29f69:, 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:38187938a49834fe00949d55ee7bc101:) are not present in the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:90d3cb1fab8e922e6e4d58daa901fc39: at all.

      Against this decomposition, the pilot boundary set out in the introduction of the Onboarding Process section is summarised below.

      Element Within APTITUDE Onboarding UI, Registration Service (with the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:0de07f9f47d393abf90c0c45071215ab: and its API), 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:c9f71d6b63fa69fd9107de90223667c9:, 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:a59b78125f548cb0e5a2eda1cf70bea5:, Sign/Seal Certificate Issuance Services, and Publication Service (with the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:7a5c4b8600cf3a41229429c72e388a41:) Implemented as pilot software Trust infrastructure setup (prerequisites) Performed out of band; no pilot software The Member State to European Commission notification act, and the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:de646ceead3a5a65401fdd013564a01b: publication Mocked, respectively by the Publication Service and by the pilot The certification of a 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:684130882f3ecb329603f83cd9b0dc3e:<__None__> External; out of scope of the pilot and only referenced Data schemas, certificate profiles, 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:84e96068baa84ffb9046f1d4c9e167bd: formats, low-level protocols Defined in the referenced sections of this specification, not redefined here

docs.title: Input
docs.text:
The required inputs to onboard an operational entity depend on its type and on the onboarding path it follows (see Onboarding Paths by Entity Type). The following inputs SHALL be required:

  • Registration data of entities that are registered in the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:f9b0af32c6541f4639f8764ffc7ac9ff:<__None__>, i.e., all 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:50a30ce2706bc616a8178b07ecf3322f: types. This data conforms to the WalletRelyingParty schema defined in Register Data Schema, which transposes the [CIR 2025/848, Annex I] and [CIR 2025/848-Amendment, Annex VI] set.
  • Notifiable data of entities published in a 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:714494a2e8417bf14e7205c64bce5aff:, i.e., 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:88e5cd8b9dbe44608d17c4ddd9769274:, 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:11fec24cd76b3ed3abaf50a0f5f7268b:, 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:563fdcfd8fc230343b72e12ff88a6cb4:, 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:b72ebde5724bc00f2d635fdd23867133:, and the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:f0a6f859ea3691526511f8b268610c4e:. This data covers the identification, 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:bc0267607dec5983ce03965011dbffd9:, and service supply points needed for the relevant 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:983d61e237267d193edfa8bc6763f97c: entry, as defined in List of Trusted Entities.
  • Cryptographic material, namely the cryptographic material for which a 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:cbfd0946138af3d8ac0cb14494d25212: requests a 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:c27a0224f2642aaf5d7ffbdfefbfcb77:, generated according to [ETSI TS 119 411-8], and the cryptographic material for which 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:a00c1aa709981740e1d1222cdc461508:, 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:4c5c6b1c469c8990231b65a3d1163035:, or 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:64ce09329dc041f089c90a6cca0d7c69: request Sign/Seal Certificates used to sign or seal their 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:c646dd21c6e3ac33d1c10e35564bda5b:.

    Note

    A 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:d8cf9c8b09094d9369c70d5b13adba03: that is also a notified entity (PID, PuB-EAA, QEAA, or non-qualified EAA Provider) provides both the registration data and the notifiable data: the former populates the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:94f41240f58bdbc686a36e96096ea174:<__None__> and drives the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:c8559c15df33914ba315b827c437bfee:, the latter populates the corresponding 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:399af330b2f5f13660067db9908c2fb7:. A 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:adbcbf27cf13a4cb7ceaf8df8c4d90c6: or a 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:3bc8cf6148881116a6b8d0ef7a5b7597: provides only the registration data, as it requires no 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:4c6d086d0829d7bbe2302211cbeff710: entry.

docs.title: Output
docs.text:
A successful onboarding produces the artifacts below, whose data model and format are normatively specified in the referenced sections:

  • the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:43e3792383d45665d5348a73dbe6e01a:<__None__> entry and its publication, see Register Data Schema and Common Register API;
  • the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:8df5f8db43696ef80a5ebd87ba644dab:, see Wallet-Relying Party Access Certificate;
  • the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:e271bfaefe7e80123c5ba65bb2ef0b91:, see Wallet-Relying Party Registration Certificate;
  • the applicable Sign/Seal Certificate for 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:f768e166927223901bb1bdfee14d98b0:, 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:b4a3f504f81da02db687cb93050c5176:, or 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:23e4c5e128331e07bc511b7f77cb0674:, see Entity Sign/Seal Certificate Profile;
  • the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:36f489390a84dba311aa4e1637d3a11d: entry produced by the Notification and Publication step.

docs.text:
Each entity type follows a different path and produces a different set of outputs, summarised in the table below.

The steps below describe the onboarding journey: any 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:c88e0ceaa441c63eb814bedb5162ed99: entity type goes through Data Collection and Registration Record Creation, Certificate Issuance and, where it is also a notified entity, Notification and Publication; the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:d5ba4674252fd6bc65bd0c172123c126: goes through Certificate Issuance for its Sign/Seal Certificate and Notification and Publication, without a registration record.

docs.title: Data Collection and Registration Record Creation
docs.text:
This step produces the registration record for a 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:027ac189d5d2a96514e175dd3360d7f6:.

The entity submits its registration data through the Onboarding UI, which forwards the request to the Registration Service (6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:c66372e8cfd86a84be05765392d84ad9:<__None__>).

Within APTITUDE, registration SHALL be restricted to APTITUDE Partners, and the Onboarding System SHALL enforce this restriction [ONBOARD-REG-01]. This replaces the identity proofing of [ETSI TS 119 461] and the verification duties of [CIR 2025/848, Article 6] (REGISTRAR-REG-04 to REGISTRAR-REG-07, not restated here). The mechanism by which participation is established, for example a pre-provisioned list of participants, or a membership check, is an implementation choice; a non-participant SHALL NOT be registered, and onboarding SHALL NOT proceed.

On successful verification, the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:f9e4c9bfee9702ac36aca628d164e665:<__None__> SHALL create the record through the common 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:c901891bb827e0b16f640481816f4cdb:<__None__> write API (POST /wrp, see Common Register API), using a body conforming to the WalletRelyingParty schema of Register Data Schema, and SHALL set the registration status to active. Write access to the API SHALL be authenticated and restricted to the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:c0e9ac520d87ebf05f6068148611219e:<__None__> [ONBOARD-REG-02]; the concrete credential mechanism (for example a bearer token or mutual TLS) is an implementation choice. When published or queried, the record is electronically signed/sealed by or on behalf of the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:b6d2d42e04d9f3ec3a515bffd1045724:<__None__> (REGISTER-PUB-05).

docs.title: Certificate Issuance
docs.text:
This step issues the applicable certificates for an operational entity. For a 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:7c1cc7e8580080d6ae2c2a89a47d06ca:, 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:163c34673928f35a591067c36c2d09bb: and 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:a767c92f8b5a30e707a2d17ff25a7247: issuance starts once its registration record is active; a 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:b60b1f9c76f32ebb5a5148d40d836732: requests its Sign/Seal Certificate without a registration record.

The request/issuance protocol is an implementation choice (for example ACME, EST, or a manual exchange); the enrolment SHOULD include a 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:88e38ff528cdad05d207e991140cb4c0: of the private key corresponding to the certified public key, a property inherited from the certificate-policy framework underlying [ETSI TS 119 411-8]. The verifications below apply regardless of the protocol.

  • 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:c2ee83a85f04cf6948fc821ee9f3707b:. The 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:2a9021f27b925dd82fbc3e0ea61bd3e1: issues one or more 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:873859f6ee98b222a108a13392ad5aa7:, whose content and format are defined in Wallet-Relying Party Access Certificate. A 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:76b15cf7988d7afc3bde096786d0ddbf: receives a separate 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:a981dba8213344d5a2484b0f9f047498: for each of its 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:8fa756b755089f10777eab56647503bb: (Reg_10a). At issuance time it SHALL verify that the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:c207d66a1136840f8ad147f6d7940513: has an active registration status and that the certificate information is consistent with the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:6788e9b24f60832b853cd12467b135e6:<__None__> (requirement PROVIDER-WRPAC-01 in Register, from [CIR 2025/848, Annex IV 3(c)]); its attributes are derived from the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:6c767ffbe452c336f2814d7a4050e260:<__None__> information ([ETSI TS 119 475, Clause 5.1.2]). If the registration is not active or the data are inconsistent, the Provider SHALL refuse to issue the certificate.
  • 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:1e44c9906a858b16c911c6732f5ed5db:. The 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:f8d07c18c2eca54c1bf784a8249e68dd: issues a 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:7f90a21e302ccfc954389c9731ae9eb0:, whose content and format are defined in Wallet-Relying Party Registration Certificate. At issuance time it SHALL verify the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:829d02b3a96727e123bdc586761d8327:<__None__> status, the consistency with the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:75692ac0deeff94f84710bd68a9d4670:<__None__> information, and the validity of the corresponding 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:dfc3f1c165747336681b2eedd1a37eb3: when relevant (requirement PROVIDER-WRPRC-02 in Register, from [CIR 2025/848, Annex V 3(c)]). The same failure handling applies.
  • Sign/Seal Certificate. The Sign/Seal Certificate Issuance Service realises the Provider of Sign/Seal Certificates role and issues the applicable certificate to 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:ad74a223786a5850028635053896937c:, 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:b72075939bd81f83cf88fe62ee3a43c2:, and 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:f27280714d78af20f4c381aae43bb27e:, for signing or sealing 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:0192b3974ad77450ce5f06b5e1d3114f:, 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:e8a4e7e88bfb6bed300d663c58dfe5ad:, or 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:1227c2bc992d7cc2f34814e0418b0a21:, respectively. Its content and format SHALL conform to the applicable Entity Sign/Seal Certificate Profile. The issued certificate is an end-entity certificate, distinct from the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:45244f149d86684e194e4d84ff546e0a:<__None__> published in the applicable 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:43a02c64cdea0d10dcd5f44c237a8bd9:; its certificate chain SHALL terminate at that trust anchor.

    APTITUDE Implementation Choice

    In the normative baseline, the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:6d9c751154b0dfda6482aac213a0cc64: is created during the registration process by a 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:fb69a17f55a923cd1f337b3d321cde29: associated to the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:298f62e981923b2d92eaba725bf0ef2f:<__None__> (RPRC_09, RPRC_13), and no certificate-based request step is described. The presentation of the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:fcbed7bf13c2aed6167acd363b39276b: when requesting the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:6df1a44f9bf75ca0781d1c738cb0232c:, shown in the Detailed flow, is therefore an APTITUDE-specific design choice, which gives the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:35af39656666f7c2bbb5ffcad436de7b: direct evidence for the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:b7e927e328f7dae49bf0998c8986d6d2: validity verification required by PROVIDER-WRPRC-02.

    Identity proofing is not repeated here; it is performed by the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:0139b6c887e4b70dab8c33cfc10c53ec:<__None__> at Data Collection and Registration Record Creation. After issuance, the entity deploys each 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:ff2a7ebef0151ce63a480b1e7acf01d7: at the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:5e813bddea778eceb378c042b17f0c9f:<__None__> for which it was issued (Reg_10a), provides its 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:657c6cf1a3bcbe686532ae63ce317355: to its 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:49f8122099a15ad0532a40cb3e23cbca: or service supply points and, for an 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:a6c22976c61a8d1155cc90cbcf072b08:, includes it in the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:3b1d6cabe74e5d117e5ba751ae9c693e:<__None__> used at issuance (RPRC_10, RPRC_14, RPRC_22). A 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:19e7b8e99e930ca6084da37ec469d1f9: or 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:865db92a9bda8879bd9ca1b0f6083f33: deploys its Sign/Seal Certificate at the service supply point that signs or seals 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:f1559bf7c6e1a8c6bd84c7294e4df748: or 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:110dbef58463273aa0fc63279a14a057:; a 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:7ced79788e7c7db2eaa5b2d6a10e0026: deploys it at the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:e20c94c8bcfbaa6208f75152bca8d047:<__None__> service that signs or seals 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:7504bc4d83501579fea7df935b344562:.

docs.title: Notification and Publication
docs.text:
This step publishes a notified entity, together with the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:c9cbda657ecc42f27fd32ff2c6ddf456:<__None__> of the technical component it operates, in the appropriate 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:e0e6c2e2c6afecbad0bce5f866c9b486:. 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:4f19573367afe3a211d3bd8d5d1b292e: is a separate, Member State level process ([CIR 2024/2980]) and is not a duty of the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:7186acbe27475dc33fcd1be15946875f:<__None__>. Within APTITUDE, the Member State to European Commission notification act SHALL be mocked by the Publication Service, triggered by the Onboarding UI, while the signing and publication of the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:9094096f9c836e063b3c5567e9ffc526: SHALL follow the normative framework [ONBOARD-PUB-01].

For a 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:911b194e9363eab5917049028b970c05:, 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:0e1f9954f75e8e7a9cf180f87593142e:, or 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:fcc87485e71c230251e6d7846bba6496:, the applicable Sign/Seal Certificate SHALL be issued before the notification data is submitted. The Sign/Seal Certificate is the notified entity's end-entity certificate and is distinct from both the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:7c7882bc972c5bc3b800b574eb1702b3:<__None__> published in the applicable 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:9baf2eafefbbbbb7c967f03512d5da5d: and the certificate used by the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:355a5d315df37110ba6c714e7facd4fb: to sign the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:88c4f3aec7e182b0f735900ef9e84206:.

  • 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:9d1bc26a13e2438bb491ecbf4cfddb93: and 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:9e8a822c1351d0b7a321447b923ea8e4: are added to the respective 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:a82b2dd94f46198e57b623289775a70b:.
  • 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:5430cb04d5cf141c4c73bfdec44bcbc1: follow a 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:b3e3b31f3fe3dc5c78d6a530762318ad:-only path, with no 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:92cdcf568f7ff59f132c5e962de129f0:<__None__> record, no 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:c9f02c14c02ef43a913827936904e65b:, and no 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:7e9d9953a75b708fe4388f6337d03677:; their Sign/Seal Certificates are issued before their 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:7e75347bd9c0dcdd9e51d30d655100f4:<__None__> is published in the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:35570d6c6ff7e2cdd48d1c9451c795b0: 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:24e5911a52ef8b72cbb76ed6690ac4fc:;
  • 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:43f71919e06e51bf182279b93e0f2520: and 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:6703705ecfe1158e66977edde0cd6707: require no 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:ed2087bb81ff87ae874506bbd1083243: entry, as trust in it is anchored through the signed 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:389fcb7119f1c18f14e51767a4b03a89:<__None__> and its 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:7bf722c8cbe0cf0e5f182c12416b7959:.

    Note

    The Sign/Seal Certificate issued to a 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:baab375c0782a9f080f68d0a698d6ab6: or 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:052d364caa0e1d0edc51939dc42b0e7b: is the end-entity certificate with which its service supply point signs or seals 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:fb666ddb40e589014a3d477bec96e171: or 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:f8ec770e08deb5aea7537886efe4ae0c:; for a 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:871f6da7a8e2fa71d6b494c390223a0f: it is the certificate used by the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:c03cbf6027b3a7b139bb205f03d28b23:<__None__> to sign or seal 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:251075cfd7796adbf0b8edf5540f7257:. The corresponding 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:bb0d13e00f1847f538d31b2576df6102:<__None__> published in the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:134fb4c5c4a59345509167f2f9ade619: is the CA certificate at which the Sign/Seal Certificate chain terminates. The 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:cfbae16c355c24a32665f52b5cbed1e4: entry therefore binds the organisational entity to the technical component that operates at runtime.

    On failure, if publication does not complete, a notified entity MAY already hold its issued Sign/Seal Certificate and, where it is a 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:dd418ffe24d3fc0fa5ef4be1ae9ebfcd:, have an active registration record and hold its 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:d14d8a89f6ab4b5b1f7882251c5ed5bd: and 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:4694365c51a723f756b1b69a8c402362:, but not yet be present in the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:ac6ea81ef5e88047752074fe26b4ea0e:. The issued certificate and registration record alone do not make the entity trusted by 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:184d13f6435598ae20968cc591a6dbb6: until the entry is published.

docs.title: Detailed Flow
docs.text:
sequenceDiagram
    participant E as Operational Entity
    participant UI as Onboarding UI
    participant RegServ as Registration Service
    participant Register as WRP Register
    participant ACServ as WRPAC Issuance Service
    participant RCServ as WRPRC Issuance Service
    participant SSCServ as Sign/Seal Certificate Issuance Service
    participant PubServ as Publication Service
    participant TL as LoTE

    E->>UI: submit onboarding data and cryptographic material
    alt entity registers (any WRP)
        UI->>RegServ: create registration (registration data + crypto material)
        RegServ->>RegServ: ensure entity is an APTITUDE participant (mocked proofing)
        RegServ<<->>Register: write data
        RegServ-->>UI: response with status active
        UI->>ACServ: request WRPAC
        ACServ->>RegServ: request verification of active status and consistency
        RegServ<<->>Register: get data
        RegServ-->>ACServ: response with active status
        ACServ->>ACServ: check data consistency
        ACServ-->>UI: WRPAC
        UI-->>E: provide WRPAC
        E->>UI: request WRPRC (with WRPAC)
        UI->>RCServ: request WRPRC
        RCServ->>RCServ: check WRPAC validity (when relevant)
        RCServ->>RegServ: request verification of active status and consistency
        RegServ<<->>Register: get data
        RegServ-->>RCServ: response with active status
        RCServ->>RCServ: check data consistency
        RCServ-->>UI: WRPRC
        UI-->>E: provide WRPRC
        opt PID / PuB-EAA / QEAA / EAA Providers
            E->>UI: request Sign/Seal Certificate
            UI->>SSCServ: request Sign/Seal Certificate (with cryptographic material)
            SSCServ->>RegServ: request verification of active status and consistency
            RegServ<<->>Register: get data
            RegServ-->>SSCServ: response with active status
            SSCServ->>SSCServ: check data and applicable certificate profile
            SSCServ-->>UI: Sign/Seal Certificate
            UI-->>E: provide Sign/Seal Certificate
            UI->>PubServ: submit notifiable data
            PubServ<<->>TL: publish to applicable LoTE
            PubServ-->>UI: entry successfully created
            UI-->>E: publication confirmed
        end
    else Wallet Providers
        E->>UI: request Sign/Seal Certificate
        UI->>SSCServ: request Sign/Seal Certificate (with cryptographic material)
        SSCServ->>SSCServ: check request and applicable certificate profile
        SSCServ-->>UI: Sign/Seal Certificate
        UI-->>E: provide Sign/Seal Certificate
        UI->>PubServ: submit notifiable data
        PubServ<<->>TL: publish to Wallet Providers LoTE
        PubServ-->>UI: entry successfully created
        UI-->>E: publication confirmed
    end

docs.title: Connection to Lifecycle Management
docs.text:
Onboarding is the first phase of the lifecycle of an entity and of the artifacts produced for it. This subsection summarises how onboarding connects to the Trust Management Process and distinguishes the lifecycle of registered entities from that of notified entities.

For entities that are registered in the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:a30e7315e34ae54911288cfc52a9368f:<__None__>, the registration record follows the status model below.

stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Active: onboarding completed
    Active --> Active: update of registration data
    Active --> Cancelled: cancellation
    Cancelled --> [*]
  • Update. A change to the registration data triggers the corresponding update of the dependent artifacts. The 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:20906da43532e2b2ac1708e09f0b07a4: and the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:7f83dc57b6e43949c87b7ebaf4169659: SHALL monitor the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:89065adfcc5a66a5c6839b54cf9a7ec3:<__None__> and reissue or revoke the affected 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:dfc8cda82dc2800686aa946fed96b58d: or 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:b3946c649ade280fbba64053606a1e88: when the change requires it (requirements PROVIDER-WRPAC-02 and PROVIDER-WRPRC-03 in Register), and the corresponding 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:1b94af0d1cf1b7e25b2c92aceae7b3fb: entry is updated where applicable.
  • Cancellation / De-onboarding. Setting the registration status to cancelled (or deleting the record) triggers the revocation of any dependent 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:0d169ffdbc0d0ebd8788b89041e3f4e6: and 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:f210981b2d3ce483009be4b27b828afe: by the respective providers. The revocation mechanisms (6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:e6b410bdf4c0b9a135a1add2d064c3c0: or 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:327754ecf423f255afc123e869447304: for 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:3b03eee4f55bcafad4af66f39b9cc21b:; 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:67e0f3ecec3dd22d1f7a5f78e30872a9: for 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:15f8febc054e461b9c32a5b0f55f1a35:) are defined in Revocation Mechanisms.

    These actions SHALL act on the organisational entity, that is its registration and the certificates issued to it, and not on the technical product it operates [ONBOARD-LC-02]. The certification lifecycle of the technical product, in particular the certification of a 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:07502edcda89f590ea1540ba81f1d5fb:<__None__>, is a separate process, out of scope of this document. A change to that certification that does not affect the entity's eligibility SHALL be reflected as a 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:1b3e835690ea6133ea3000f1600b4b12: update and SHALL NOT, by itself, be treated as de-onboarding. A change that makes the entity no longer eligible SHALL instead lead to its cancellation, whose effect on the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:aaac2eedce4c9f07409731640b064c75: is defined by ONBOARD-LC-01 [ONBOARD-LC-03].

    The lifecycle of entities that are only notified is governed by the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:85462f20831541a1a49b29c864c8bebf: framework ([CIR 2024/2980]). The entity is published when notified, and upon cancellation it stops being trusted (ARF GenNot_05). For the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:5d1278f545cfa63095afa3bec410b09c:, a cancellation additionally requires the revocation of all its valid 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:c806952792703cfc5bbbe213a59291a4: (ARF WPNot_06). The same applies to the other notified entities published in their 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:fb82b42b5b36b71dc86d9c513746d629:.

    How stops being trusted is represented depends on the list type, and APTITUDE adopts the representation already supported by each format. The PuB-EAA Provider 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:dfffc3a5b5fdb4e6b12754cdc2d56f70: carries an explicit per-entry status, which on cancellation SHALL be set to withdrawn or invalid; the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:92dc10d130d004581a7257763211d25e:, 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:0625e20f57d8a13bddb49f577ffaa96f:, 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:aa4188fcf28f1265b1d2e9d9ee01e0bf:, 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:d9880bb0229278839ea0e8bbb4f35bfb:, and 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:8171388ed90ff351a4d997c498c5e04c:<__None__> 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:dbb0ace7b5f12df6787b527651db605b: carry no per-entry status (per [ETSI TS 119 602], ServiceStatus and the service history are not used for these types), so for them a cancelled entity SHALL be reflected by removing the entry [ONBOARD-LC-01]. The broader lifecycle of notified entities belongs to the Trust Management Process.

    Finally, the artifacts produced by onboarding are consumed in the trust evaluation processes. docs.title: Common Register API
docs.text:
This section documents a [TS05] aligned common 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:8da218c67aa4d5068ea5601771003dba:<__None__> API profile that satisfies [CIR 2025/848, Annex II] and [CIR 2025/848-Amendment] constraints.

Note

The OpenAPI Specification (OAS) of the API described in this section is available in this page.

APTITUDE Implementation Choice

The 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:07d441445d68495510c056410eb8ca68:<__None__> SHALL be managed by APTITUDE WP2. Information is entered into the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:90cb72911573111f9cc005f2034d884f:<__None__> through a dedicated Onboarding Process that does not use the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:ffb09063a3ddfe75f2b97fde7295531f:<__None__> API. Consequently, only the read operations of the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:48b714a0062c04d34983bb32f07f2958:<__None__> API are relevant to this specification and are described below.

The 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:b98c3ae7c6775096a257f769c04d7013:<__None__> read API SHALL be open for public access (no prior authentication) and return JWS-signed statements.

Warning

The name of some query parameters differ from [TS05] and the corresponding YAML file containing the OpenAPI specification of the JSON and REST based application programming interfaces (e.g., intendedusecredentialmeta vs credentialmeta). This profile follows the OpenAPI specification.

In addition, this specification adds providesattestation to cover the [CIR 2025/848-Amendment] requirement for filtering parameter: 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:52f146e59e5f30e600341e818f208459:<__None__> provided, returning the complete data set of each of the registered 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:8ac2ac21d1ad430b1feab13bd6ae39f2: matching the value provided for this parameter.

Upon success, the endpoint SHALL return a 200 OK HTTP status code and a JWT with content type application/jwt, containing the JWS compact serialization. The decoded JWS payload SHALL contain an array of WalletRelyingParty objects (matching the query), with address field excluded from published entries, and, where relevant, accompanied by 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:ab6807169b2f43c8268b48acf896f72f: history information.

In case no parameter is provided, the list of all registered 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:0d1ff4b23baf30434d75f69de8e618ea: is returned.

Note

The published API view excludes only postalAddress ([CIR 2025/848-Amendment, Annex I, point 4]). All other fields, including intended-use claims, are published as registered.

docs.title: Token Status List
docs.text:
This section profiles the Token Status List (TSL) mechanism defined in [draft-ietf-oauth-status-list] for artifacts whose status is managed using a Status List. A TSL conveys the current status of many artifacts in a compact, signed 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:48e66a5dc41b8761bf146a112c329349:<__None__>. The requirements in this profile apply unless refined by one of the artifact-specific profiles below.

The Status Issuer is the entity that issues the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:44cddde8ce039bc35bb4e377f8a7887c:<__None__> about the status information of the artifact. The Status Provider is the entity that makes the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:b12e2e32d39cda8de06513d81fec60df:<__None__> available at an accessible endpoint. The artifact-specific profile SHALL define these roles and whether they are fulfilled by the same entity.

docs.title: Status List
docs.text:
A Status List contains a compressed byte array whose entries represent the statuses of many artifacts. The artifact-specific profile SHALL define the status-list reference member. Each status-list reference SHALL contain a distinct, non-negative idx value and a uri identifying the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:c4bb872d87c74f3d296b48c7a1209633:<__None__> that contains the corresponding entry. For a JWT-encoded artifact, idx is a JSON integer and uri is a JSON string; for a CWT-encoded artifact, idx is a 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:b7f3f3504269a2a8e52fa699446478f2: unsigned integer and uri is a CBOR text string. In both cases, uri SHALL be a URI conforming to [RFC 3986].

The Status Issuer SHALL:

  • Configure the bits value as one of 1, 2, 4, or 8. This value determines the number of bits used to represent the status of each artifact and therefore the number of possible status values.
  • Create a byte array of size >= (number of artifacts) * bits / 8. Depending on bits, each byte in the array corresponds to 8, 4, 2, or 1 status values.
  • Assign each artifact to a distinct index starting at 0 and set the status value for every issued artifact at the corresponding position in the byte array. The status meanings and encoded values are defined by the artifact-specific profile.
  • Pack entries starting with the least significant bit of each byte.
  • Compress the byte array using DEFLATE [RFC 1951] with the ZLIB [RFC 1950] data format. Implementations SHOULD use the highest compression level available.

The status values and their meanings are defined by the artifact-specific profile.

docs.text: The 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:b0773fa2f17d75cc2e5884367d123625:<__None__> is available at the Status List Endpoint. The format for the Status List Token is specified in Status List Token.

docs.text:

Status List Request in JWT format

Accept: application/statuslist+jwt

    Status List

    A Status List contains a compressed byte array whose entries represent the statuses of many 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:b5d9fe696d93f5ce9932cf4b44b4a61e: or 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:54e19ce6a4c1ccfe2aeef82e695890c2:.

Both 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:729d011df3dc7e35f4579fd8e5283601: and 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:114acd7a0dcf3cf05de41d2b9cfaa7fd: are JWTs; therefore, idx is a JSON integer and uri is a JSON string in each reference. docs.title: Online Certificate Status Protocol
docs.text:
The 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:a01c0eab711b11430afcf21e2b226ff9:<__None__>, defined in [RFC 6960], enables applications to determine the exact revocation state of identified certificates. An 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:8d93b8542327f52aa16a221ee1fb5526: client issues a status request to an 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:02eb51add5194a1399606d0538549c65: responder and SHALL suspend the acceptance of the certificates in question until the responder provides a valid response.

If supported by the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:d45456957b71996e654e8f0f3ba46a18:, the URI to which the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:eb120ec8b35ab5d4ecfcff557598e530: Responder can be invoked SHALL be present in the authorityInfoAccess.accessLocation extension of the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:15549953269edd31753f22c693267381:.

This protocol specifies the data that SHALL be exchanged between the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:49238704d0c19a5e5695ad4c622f5fb6: client (which checks the status of one or more certificates) and the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:ec1ef3cedd1711f9699edbf5191fedcf: server (which provides the corresponding status). In this specific ecosystem, the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:4567d3617401d676202fbe3d867d9bc2: client can be a 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:2f056d23c19bea3c12cfc31d875d8818:<__None__> checking the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:62080f9fda2bc15b9ecf2d3e169a80ca: of a WRP, and the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:a9ed04492cde551325c07f605ee5aa4d: server is the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:f11f3ad0b79895f8986d97a1a00ac211:.

docs.title: Status list token
docs.text:
The Token Status List mechanism [draft-ietf-oauth-status-list] conveys the current status of multiple artifacts within a compact, signed object called a 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:43aad0710836aeef7c88701927db8a2f:<__None__>. This section specifies the structure of the Status List Token; the operational use of Token Status List within the APTITUDE ecosystem is detailed in Token Status List.

Status List Tokens SHALL be protected by a cryptographic signature and SHALL be encoded in either JWT or CWT format. Depending on the format used, they SHALL comply with:

  • For JWT format: [draft-ietf-oauth-status-list, Section 5.1], [RFC 7515], [RFC 7519].
  • For CWT format: [draft-ietf-oauth-status-list, Section 5.2], [RFC 8392].

APTITUDE Implementation Choice

The 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:68c6fc2aa531a6e440f7322a22d706e0:<__None__> SHALL be available in JWT format and MAY additionally be available in CWT format.

The following table details the header parameters for Status List Tokens in JWT format, including presence requirements, syntax types, descriptions, and corresponding references in [draft-ietf-oauth-status-list].

Parameter Type Presence Description Reference in [draft-ietf-oauth-status-list] alg String REQUIRED Contains the algorithm identifier for the algorithm used to sign the JWT, among those contained in the IANA "JSON Web Signature and Encryption Algorithms" registry. It SHALL NOT be set to none or to a symmetric algorithm (MAC) identifier. Section 5.1 typ String REQUIRED Specifies the JWT type. It SHALL be set to statuslist+jwt. Section 5.1 x5c String[] REQUIRED Contains the base64-encoded certificate chain required to verify the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:24e153b03da3115247b069cb5c538a9e:<__None__>'s signature. Section 5.1

The following table details the payload parameters for Status List Tokens in JWT format.

Parameter Type Presence Description Reference in [draft-ietf-oauth-status-list] sub String REQUIRED Specifies the URI of the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:694b5852276138c9ed532933c6f9c74a:<__None__>. The value SHALL be equal to that of the uri claim contained in the status_list claim of the referenced token. Section 5.1 iat NumericDate REQUIRED Represents the time at which the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:0b6f0c4bbe0327562ce1516f65e7a640:<__None__> was issued. Section 5.1 exp NumericDate REQUIRED Represents the time at which the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:cab44972dfeb1980509999b0b938167a:<__None__> is considered expired. Section 5.1 status_list JSONObject REQUIRED Contains the Status List configurations and payload. Section 5.1 ttl Integer RECOMMENDED Specifies the maximum amount of time, in seconds, that the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:baebe6e98e36a28f1c0a894ea7b30f24:<__None__> can be cached by a consumer before a fresh copy SHOULD be retrieved. Section 5.1 Example: Status List Token in JWT Format

  ]

This section extends the general X.509 Certificate Profile and specifies a Certificate Profile for entity 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:85e9f421befe04977511815ef2d72f7a:.

A 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:9de5fcf449009ed71adcd8b5d3df9317:<__None__> is an authoritative entity represented by a public key and associated data. 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:1fc4c1e16938a7ce563a0b58573d65a9:<__None__> certificates MAY be self-signed or non self-signed. In any case, 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:20a94266a2d4580c7fa6f5b2b16cb793: SHALL NOT require an additional issuer chain above a 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:408fb1fd67246e2eec21e5c725daaa14:-designated trust anchor, even if it is not self-signed, as the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:011c1f072e460a74b515f00a24e4c818:<__None__> is a trust-store input designated by policy.

  • 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:5c573337166ad9ff72faa4e6cef602dc:<__None__> certificate of the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:e4eb4f4c150a5a5037ded6b4e65c2396: SHALL NOT be present in the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:3fb9593772d1a632540891c3ab4a9947: x5c header.

    The pathLenConstraint restricts the depth of certification paths below the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:1e4c5c3a94aa4a18ae08cdb08910defc:<__None__>, as follows:

    • A value of 0 means that the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:cb5d4e8ec94f56966300f422d7e960ad:<__None__> MAY issue end-entity certificates but SHALL NOT allow additional non-self-issued intermediate 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:397e18c7495bdbfc72cd12f05c98bb7a: certificates in the path.
    • Absence of the pathLenConstraint implies that no explicit limit is imposed by the certificate itself.

      • This profile allows the field to be OPTIONAL to support interoperability with different 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:0d813b90d1c2c856f0c90d7e139b7b03: deployment models. However, setting pathLenConstraint to 0 is RECOMMENDED to reduce trust hierarchy complexity, improve predictability of certificate chains, and limit the risk associated with unintended subordinate certification authorities.

      Use Case-Specific Requirements

      Specific Use Cases could have custom 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:ff674a6c5467f12a35c7fb544308ec58:<__None__> Certificate requirements. Where strictly necessary, implementations MAY define and support additional extensions beyond the profile defined above.

  tbsCertificate: {
    version: 2,                                           // Integer value 2 for v3
    serialNumber: "0x9D846F726A8..",

    signature: AlgorithmIdentifier {
      oid: "1.2.840.113549.1.1.11",                       // sha256WithRSAEncryption
      params: NULL

      countryName: "CZ",

      commonName: "Example Entity Trust Anchor Root",
      organizationIdentifier: "VATCZ-127263789"
    },

    validity: {

      notAfter: Time.utcTime("310127000000Z")
    },

    subject: DistinguishedName {                          // SHALL match the Issuer
      countryName: "CZ",
      organizationName: "Example Entity Trust Anchor CA",
      commonName: "Example Entity Trust Anchor Root",
      organizationIdentifier: "VATCZ-127263789"
    },

    subjectPublicKeyInfo: {
      algorithm: AlgorithmIdentifier {
        oid: "1.2.840.113549.1.1.1",                      // rsaEncryption
        params: NULL
      },

      subjectPublicKey: "BASE64(SPKI_PUBLIC_KEY_BYTES)"
    },

    extensions: [
      Extension {
        oid: "2.5.29.35",                                 // authorityKeyIdentifier
        critical: false,
        value: AuthorityKeyIdentifier {
          keyIdentifier: "SHA-1(ISSUER_PUBLIC_KEY_VALUE)"
        }
      },

      Extension {
        oid: "2.5.29.14",                                 // subjectKeyIdentifier
        critical: false,
        value: SubjectKeyIdentifier("SHA-1(SUBJECT_PUBLIC_KEY_VALUE)")

      Extension {
        oid: "2.5.29.15",                                 // keyUsage

        oid: "2.5.29.19",                                 // basicConstraints
        critical: true,
        value: BasicConstraints {
          cA: true,
          pathLenConstraint: 0

      }      
    ]
  },

  signatureAlgorithm: AlgorithmIdentifier {
    oid: "1.2.840.113549.1.1.11",                         // SHALL match/align with tbsCertificate.signature
    params: NULL

  signatureValue: "BASE64(SIGN(issuerPrivateKey, DER(tbsCertificate)))"
}

    serialNumber: "0x736A63D6352..",

    extensions: [

      },

      Extension {
        oid: "2.5.29.14",                                 // subjectKeyIdentifier

      },

      Extension {
        oid: "2.5.29.15",                                 // keyUsage

  },

}

docs.title: List of Trusted Entities Retrieval and Validation Sequence Diagram
docs.text:
sequenceDiagram
  participant Client as Wallet/WRP
  participant OJA as Official Journal of APTITUDE
  participant Distribution as LoTE Distribution Point

  Client->>OJA: Request discovery for required LoTE type
  OJA-->>Client: Return type-specific location and signer certificates
