docs.title: List of Trusted Entities Validation Process
docs.text:
The validator initializes the following variables:

Input Variables:

  • Requested-LoTE-Type: The 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:a437fd33cbf695057e02dbe25976ca6a: type required for the artifact or 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:ad571757d95109cc3c8d8083e56a3957:<__None__> being validated.
  • OJA-Loc: URI of the latest known 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:a2bf1f48e88c2d37849a2c99d39640c1: publication for the requested LoTE type.
  • OJA-LoTE-Loc: URI of the last processed 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:c5dd5f6766f9457f73ab3568b6ce486c: instance for the requested type. It is initialized to the location published in the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:45b39e370d44b9230be6327e7a275b9f:.
  • OJA-LoTE-Certs-Set: The set of certificates authorized by the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:c00b516ca10b38039b3a9d2af38b4854: to verify the requested 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:f11374151c5cf6910a0af17d6358a12a: type.
  • LoTE: The JSON/JWT or XML/XAdES 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:25537637e60e1c461e16efb1f4e6bce3: currently being processed. Initialized as NULL.
  • LoTE-Format: The format of LoTE, either JSON or XML.
  • LoTE-Signer-Cert: The certificate used to verify the signature or seal on LoTE. Initialized as NULL.
  • LoTESO-Cert: The signer certificate of the current 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:3b6607b646b3915c3c52a81c284badb8: or pivot. Initialized as NULL.
  • LoTESO-Certs-Set: Certificates authorized by an authenticated PointersToOtherLoTE entry for the next pivot. Initialized as NULL.

    • Output Variables:

    • Authenticated-LoTE: The validated 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:976e63496add408cfc62c5fcb7129946: payload.
    • LoTE-Status: The validation result, for example LoTE_VERIFICATION_PASSED.
    • LoTE-Sub-Status: Detailed error codes supplementing LoTE-Status.

docs.title: JSON LoTE Signature Verification and OJA Binding
docs.text:
This procedure applies when the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:b5dab924e6bc4ab29911f12341cca294: is JSON formatted and uses the Compact JAdES Baseline B profile. In the APTITUDE profile, x5t#S256 is the selected certificate-reference implementation choice for this format. A Compact JAdES signature is a compact JWS; when the JWT representation is selected, the decoded payload SHALL contain the private LoTE claim defined in the Compact JAdES profile.

The validator SHALL perform the following operations before using any payload value for pivot discovery or trust-anchor extraction:

  1. Parse the JWS Compact Serialization into its protected header, payload, and signature parts. The protected header SHALL contain alg, iat, and x5t#S256; an algorithm value of none SHALL be rejected.
  2. Decode x5t#S256 from Base64url and compute the SHA-256 digest of the DER encoding of each certificate in the authorized certificate set. Exactly one certificate in OJA-LoTE-Certs-Set SHALL match the value. Set that certificate as LoTE-Signer-Cert.
  3. Verify the JWS signature over the JWS Signing Input using the public key in LoTE-Signer-Cert.
  4. Decode the payload. If the JWT representation is selected, require the private LoTE claim. Validate the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:721e8f1378ae257de2ac40ded425e281: object against LoTE_Payload_Json_schema.yaml; otherwise validate the JSON payload against the applicable JSON 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:8e6d8fb17f9a9523340154c44a61ba17: schema.
  5. Confirm that the LoTEType in the authenticated payload equals Requested-LoTE-Type and that the DistributionPoints value is the endpoint published by the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:4843b8b6af8ce7c84a01f26b82f46cda: for that type.

    If any operation fails, validation SHALL stop with LoTE-Status set to LoTE_VERIFICATION_FAILED and the applicable signature, certificate-binding, format, or type sub-status.

docs.title: XML LoTE Signature Verification and OJA Binding
docs.text:
This procedure applies when the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:411b903b4194141ad2aa2990efdb794e: is XML formatted and uses XAdES Baseline B. XAdES Baseline B is specified by [ETSI EN 319 132-1]; [ETSI EN 319 132-2] defines extended XAdES signatures and is not the governing specification for the Baseline B profile.

The validator SHALL perform the following operations before using any 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:ff1166148477bf8fe051d0163cfe2a05: value for pivot discovery or 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:c9cb65e65948ae738d4bb43df8793771:<__None__> extraction:

  1. Validate the XML document against the applicable 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:82e289b08c5a3f4bbd7759f16888ceb6: XML schema and locate the enveloped ds:Signature and its xades:QualifyingProperties.
  2. Validate the XML signature references, including the reference to the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:20f8b139aa2d1ca5eac8143310b73512: document with URI="", the enveloped-signature transform, and exclusive XML canonicalization. Validate the reference to xades:SignedProperties with Type="http://uri.etsi.org/01903#SignedProperties".
  3. Extract the signing certificate from ds:KeyInfo/ds:X509Data/ds:X509Certificate. The first xades:SigningCertificateV2/xades:Cert SHALL contain the digest of the DER encoding of this certificate. The digest SHALL use SHA-256 and the DigestValue SHALL use the XML signature Base64 encoding.
  4. Compare the extracted certificate, by exact DER certificate identity, with the certificates in OJA-LoTE-Certs-Set. Set the matching certificate as LoTE-Signer-Cert.
  5. Verify the XML signature using LoTE-Signer-Cert, including the signed properties and all signed 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:e41e76a0540a86af7703e03590bf52ea: data objects.
  6. Confirm that the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:58cfb93270fa3fa6333239929420af1a: type in the authenticated XML document equals Requested-LoTE-Type and that its distribution point is the endpoint published by the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:95ffc47e5358cf197f3e809321137d62: for that type.

    If any operation fails, validation SHALL stop with LoTE-Status set to LoTE_VERIFICATION_FAILED and the applicable signature, certificate-binding, format, or type sub-status. XAdES SigningCertificateV2 is not by itself a 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:e4313bf26fb18b03b065ad18737c31eb:<__None__>; the exact certificate match to the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:a35ce97766b10b35fd6188813a61a648: certificate set is required.

docs.title: LoTE Validation Operations
docs.text:
The validation SHALL perform the following steps:

  1. Initialization. Select the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:91ad011bab8ed7dfb227eb8b1dfc5f16: record for Requested-LoTE-Type, download the JSON/JWT or XML/XAdES file from OJA-LoTE-Loc, and assign it to LoTE.
  2. Parsing. Set LoTE-Format to JSON or XML. For JSON, resolve LoTE-Signer-Cert by matching the protected x5t#S256 value against the DER SHA-256 digests of the certificates in OJA-LoTE-Certs-Set. For XML, extract the signing certificate from ds:KeyInfo/ds:X509Data/ds:X509Certificate and match its xades:SigningCertificateV2 DER digest against OJA-LoTE-Certs-Set.
  3. Pivot Discovery. Iterate through the uriValue claims in the SchemeInformationURI object. Count the number of valid URIs found before encountering the URI matching OJA-Loc. Let \(n\) be that count.
    • If no URI matches OJA-Loc: Validation SHALL fail with LoTE-Status set to LoTE_VERIFICATION_FAILED and LoTE-Sub-Status set to OJA_LOCATION_INPUT_NOT_MATCHING_OJA_LOCATION_IN_LoTE. This implies a 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:416ea18c147467d872f775443475e9c2:<__None__> migration is required.
  4. 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:31d3d23ebd953e997e10bf590d24422c: Location Conflict. Check the condition: OJA-LoTE-Loc != LoTELocation AND LoTE != Content at LoTELocation.
    • (LoTELocation is the URI in the PointersToOtherLoTE claim of LoTE with SchemeTerritory = EU).
    • If TRUE: Validation SHALL stop with LoTE-Status set to LoTE_VERIFICATION_FAILED and LoTE-Sub-Status set to LoTE_FILE_CONFLICT.
    • If FALSE, proceed to the next step.
  5. 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:0da7953209ed2bd0b64b8082f45b0525: Freshness. Check the condition: OJA-LoTE-Loc == LoTELocation AND LoTE != Content at LoTELocation.
    • If TRUE: Set OJA-LoTE-Loc to LoTELocation and restart from Step 1.
    • If FALSE, proceed to the next step.
  6. Digital Signature Validation. Validate the cryptographic signature of the current LoTE using the format-specific Compact JAdES or XAdES Baseline B procedure and the public key from LoTE-Signer-Cert.
    • If validation fails: Stop with LoTE-Status set to LoTE_VERIFICATION_FAILED and LoTE-Sub-Status set to LoTE_SIGNATURE_VERIFICATION_FAILED.
    • If successful:
      • Set LoTESO-Cert to LoTE-Signer-Cert.
      • Set LoTESO-Certs-Set to the certificates found in the PointersToOtherLoTE claim (territory EU) of the current LoTE payload.
  7. Intermediate Pivot Validation.
    • Case \(n=0\) (No Pivots): Proceed directly to Step 8.
    • Case \(n>0\) (History Chain):
      • Iterate \(i\) from 1 to \(n\) (from most recent Pivot to oldest). Let Pivot be the file downloaded from the \(i\)-th URI.
      • Link Check. Set Pivot-Certs-Set to the certificates in the PointersToOtherLoTE claim (territory EU) of Pivot. If LoTESO-Cert (the signer of the previous file in the chain) is not in Pivot-Certs-Set, validation SHALL fail with LoTE-Sub-Status set to PIVOT_i-1_SIGNER_CERT_NOT_AUTHENTICATED_BY_PIVOT_i.
      • Update Signer. For JSON Pivot, resolve LoTESO-Cert by matching its protected x5t#S256 value against Pivot-Certs-Set. For XML Pivot, extract the signing certificate from ds:KeyInfo/ds:X509Data/ds:X509Certificate and match its xades:SigningCertificateV2 DER digest against Pivot-Certs-Set.
      • Verify Signature. Validate the signature of Pivot using the applicable Compact JAdES or XAdES Baseline B procedure and LoTESO-Cert. If it fails, validation SHALL fail with LoTE-Status set to LoTE_VERIFICATION_FAILED, and LoTE-Sub-Status set to PIVOT_i_SIGNATURE_VERIFICATION_FAILED.
      • The loop continues, walking backwards until LoTESO-Cert represents the signer of the oldest Pivot.
  8. 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:aee858deb8eca6aa3b2e428cd64b44c4:<__None__> Validation. Verify the end of the chain. If LoTESO-Cert (from the last Pivot or current 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:3a189f3eee57d6f2e46573249777492d:) is not in OJA-LoTE-Certs-Set (the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:1068d5501d1191b309a3dbc37efeaa4d:<__None__>), validation SHALL fail with LoTE-Sub-Status set to PIVOT_n_SIGNER_CERT_NOT_AUTHENTICATED_BY_OJA.
  9. Expiration. If current time > NextUpdate claim of LoTE, validation SHALL fail.
  10. Success. Set Authenticated-LoTE to LoTE, LoTE-Status to LoTE_VERIFICATION_PASSED, and LoTE-Sub-Status to an empty list.
  11. Update Bookmark. If OJA-LoTE-Loc does not match the LoTELocation in Authenticated-LoTE (territory EU), update OJA-LoTE-Loc to that value.
  12. Update Anchor. [Caution: This step modifies the Root of Trust configuration]
    • If OJA-Loc does not match the first URI in SchemeInformationURI, update OJA-LoTE-Loc.
    • Update OJA-LoTE-Certs-Set according to the new 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:6a67708297257f3005bbf989d652cce5:<__None__> from a new 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:51c49eaa1ebba46e2ffdb3c716b24dfb: publication for the requested 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:72b8d3c988320f69f7e717ab7fafacc7: type.

      Warning

      The 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:ab06cc1d58c9d24f4ea210e08dbd5e9d: validation process is mutuated from the [ETSI TS 119 615] standard, and adapted to the APTITUDE profiles context.

      Remarks

      • The 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:44365470de7d4b5d340009eb3b56b83c: record is type-specific: a validator SHALL NOT use the endpoint or certificate set published for one 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:54463e406da7fd8fc0964377f1bb306c: type to validate another 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:9c6a66d211eee99e540d22315e95e115: type.
      • The JSON x5t#S256 value binds the JWS signer to an 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:f3611dcdd10fc813efde64c239e82875:-published certificate by the SHA-256 digest of its DER encoding. The XML SigningCertificateV2 value provides the corresponding XAdES certificate digest, and the validator additionally performs exact certificate matching against the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:f02feba766d3cf784998949b1f13bf06: certificate set.
      • Payload fields are not trusted for pivot discovery, distribution-point changes, or 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:129f8d329f4f29f39f9e587be219d41c:<__None__> extraction until the format-specific signature and 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:bc7290a0f147a8e240dc48c0b1cc8479: certificate binding have succeeded.
      • A cached 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:1c0cd00533e3b4ed67489ea1c18df51b: and its 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:25783bef0db8983af042458b49bc70d1:-authorized signer certificate MAY be reused only within the caching rules specified in the LoTE profile; the cache SHALL be refreshed no later than NextUpdate and when the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:20a5af1ee9902fb07223aa19022a891d: record changes.

        Below is a flowchart summarizing the validation of a 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:ee79e7a1e0cce89a10b2d026408aefcf::

    classDef failure fill:#f8d7da,stroke:#721c24,color:#721c24,font-weight:bold;

    Start([Start LoTE JWT Validation]) --> Init[1. Init & Download LoTE<br/>from OJA-LoTE-Loc]:::process
    Init --> Parse[2. Parse Header:<br/>Extract Signer Cert x5c]:::process

    Parse --> S3{3. Found OJA-Loc URI in history?}:::decision
    S3 -- "No (NotFound)" --> F3[Fail: OJA Loc Not Found<br/>Trust Anchor Migration Needed]:::failure

    %% Steps 4 & 5: Location & Freshness Checks
    S3 -- "Yes (Set n)" --> S4{4. Location Conflict?<br/>Old-LoTE-Loc != New-LoTE-Loc AND <br/> Old-LoTE != New-LoTE}:::decision

    %% Step 7: The Loop
    SetupVars --> S7Check{"7. Is n = 0 (no Pivots)?"}:::decision
    S7Check -- Yes --> S8

        SigCheckPivot -- Invalid --> FSigPivot[Fail: Pivot Sig Invalid]:::failure

    LoopNext -- "Yes (i++)" --> DownloadPivot

    S8 -- Yes --> S9{9. Expiration Check:<br/>Now > NextUpdate?}:::decision
    S9 -- Yes --> F9[Fail: LoTE Expired]:::failure

    %% Step 10: Success

    Success --> UpdateBM[11. Update Local Bookmark OJA-LoTE-Loc<br/>if changed in payload]:::process

    F3 --> EndFail([Stop: Validation FAILED]):::failure

docs.title: Trust architecture
docs.text: This section defines the APTITUDE Trust Architecture, including all components that enable the functional trust evaluation mechanisms used within the APTITUDE ecosystem. It first identifies the entities involved in the Large Scale Pilot, then describes the infrastructure through which APTITUDE WP2 establishes their trust, and finally introduces the Onboarding System that renders those entities operational and recognizable within the ecosystem.

docs.title: Entities
docs.text:
The APTITUDE Large Scale Pilot implement business use cases that exercise interactions within the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:1cfbcd2564b34170460db197f57e064b:<__None__> ecosystem. As a result, the roles defined by that ecosystem remain applicable, while the supporting trust infrastructure is realized specifically within the APTITUDE boundaries. The main entities involved in APTITUDE are:

  • The 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:7207dc43f7e7588d3823dd2d085679db:<__None__>, who controls and uses a 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:df53b54a1b5133ba3ba09302ddb6843c:<__None__>, that is a configuration of a 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:098348279402493b9c7b6a86512fda8c:<__None__> provided by a 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:6b463eb651be83d871044d18c306af88:<__None__>.
  • 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:81d916e72f5f81fd300845da39a5969a:, which interact with the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:65f3366bd90b3850b4744a95729ff11e:<__None__> in one or both of the following capacities:
    • 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:1b784e1f8729df3dc99fa30c0cdc6ea8: and 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:4645439c2c256b57e6b56904ceee2892: issue 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:9de4173cd61e9f9c10e228b08f049896: or 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:5ad92d3eaf1ea4a9227a46a81b9366a3: to the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:c946e194362c58cafdeb299bd921cbf0:<__None__>. 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:ab7098a471aa32cc1ad7ef734158513e: comprise:

docs.title: Trust Infrastructure
docs.text:
The APTITUDE Large Scale Pilot does not deploy the full-stack Member State and European Commission infrastructure assumed by the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:9a4ff91504200b6c9e9e56b4033a2d4d:<__None__> framework. For piloting purposes, APTITUDE WP2 operates the corresponding capabilities regarding registration, certificate issuance, and publication of 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:5b4361932cbd313d723d4327f4cbe618:. Together, these capabilities establish the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:9c15dc0312ded1f34dc012f28c15ff76: and trust artifacts used by the Trust Evaluation Processes.

The trust infrastructure employed for APTITUDE consists of:

  • The APTITUDE 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:92938c5a33c220f2535f0d0390fcaff9:, which issues and manages the X.509 certificates required by the ecosystem.
  • The Registration Service and 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:798df23cdee55e973166db8edd9af582:<__None__>, which record the identity, role, and authorization information of 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:23f40711472f1632396d83e5ed9c5a17:.
  • The Certificate Issuance Services, which issue and manage 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:966d46b72689a31de1e25a8b8c7958d6: and 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:cb07246564679a7ddd50850c04b76348: during onboarding. The PKI also issues and manages the Entity Sign/Seal Certificates used by entities.
  • The Publication Service, which signs and publishes the applicable 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:ffe921e63af7ff877a179b90b171bd79:.
  • The Onboarding UI, which coordinates these services for each entity requesting onboarding.

docs.title: Trust Service Overview
docs.text:
The trust infrastructure capabilities are exposed through the APTITUDE Onboarding System. In this specification, Onboarding System denotes the aggregate logical system, while Service denotes one of its constituent components (Registration, WRPAC Issuance, WRPRC Issuance, Sign/Seal Certificate Issuance or Publication).

The Onboarding System operates on a trust infrastructure whose entities are established and whose 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:cbe385aeea96d9d2d53ffb78dd1bf925: are published before operational entity onboarding starts. Within APTITUDE, this one-time prerequisite is established out of band with no pilot software and is not part of the recurring onboarding flow. The recurring process enables APTITUDE operational entities to obtain the trust artifacts required for interactions within the ecosystem. Its detailed inputs, outputs, and entity-specific paths are defined in Onboarding Process.

The Onboarding UI is the APTITUDE-specific orchestrator and single point of contact for an entity requesting onboarding. It collects the submitted data and SHALL trigger the applicable stages in order: registration, certificate issuance, and, where applicable, publication or update of the relevant 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:706b32194662279deff0cdf5b633771f: entry:

  1. A 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:3c8a2068a383b646dfbdbbe3867d9846: submits its registration data to the Registration Service. Within APTITUDE, registration SHALL be restricted to APTITUDE Partners; the Registration Service SHALL otherwise rely on the submitted self-declaration and SHALL NOT perform the identity proofing defined in [ETSI TS 119 461] or [CIR 2025/848, Article 6]. After successful verification, the Registration Service creates an active record in the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:2a1dbd41c5076ccced882b445291a3d4:.
  2. After the registration record is active, the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:11732b8e0f6fa6dd1fcae77f094e01ae: requests the applicable 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:a3131eccf3a6039a69752ecda71b3274: and 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:133819d75cce122c352758a49adbbf1d:. The certificate issuance stage also covers Sign/Seal Certificates where applicable.
  3. docs.title: Common Presentation Trust Evaluation Model
docs.text:
The authorization logic is common to 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:4f9f830e4ebce997ddea3546770c6fa6: and 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:4619fdc11c6883266bf493b7a0e1d91d: flows. The differences are limited to the transport, the location and format of the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:d57b4ce877be26f179a97550de431cd0:, and the way requested attributes are extracted. 

flowchart TD
Start([Presentation request received])
Start --> A1[Check 1: Authenticate WRP/RPI using WRPAC]
A1 --> A1D{WRPAC authentication OK?}
    A1D -->|No| StopAuth[Stop: Authorization Process SHALL NOT start]
A1D -->|Yes| U1{User opted in to RP verification?}
U1 -->|No| SkipReg[Skip registration verification block]
U1 -->|Yes| E1[Check 2: Extract authorization evidence]
E1 --> E2{WRPRC present?}
E2 -->|Yes| W1[Check 3A: Validate WRPRC]
W1 --> W1D{WRPRC valid?}
W1D -->|Yes| B1[Check 4: Binding verification]
W1D -->|No| R1[Check 3B: Query and validate Register data]
E2 -->|No| R1
R1 --> R1D{Register data valid?}
R1D -->|No| AdvNoData[Advisory: RP cannot be fully verified]
R1D -->|Yes| B1
B1 --> B1D{Binding OK?}
B1D -->|No| StopBind[Stop: NOT_AUTHORIZED / binding failure]
B1D -->|Yes| I1{Intermediary scenario?}
I1 -->|Yes| I2[Check 5: Verify intermediary association]
I2 --> I2D{Association OK?}
I2D -->|No| StopInt[Stop: INTERMEDIARY_NOT_AUTHORIZED]
I2D -->|Yes| Ent1[Check 6: Entitlement verification on final RP context]
I1 -->|No| Ent1
Ent1 --> EntD{Service_Provider entitlement present?}
EntD -->|No| AdvEnt[Advisory: wrong entitlement]
EntD -->|Yes| S1[Check 7: Scope comparison]
AdvEnt --> UserReg{User decision on advisory}
AdvNoData --> UserReg
UserReg -->|Deny| Deny1[Deny presentation]
UserReg -->|Proceed| EDP1[Check 8: EDP evaluation]
S1 --> SD{Requested attributes within registered scope?}
SD -->|No| AdvScope[Advisory: over-asking detected]
SD -->|Yes| EDP1
AdvScope --> UserReg
SkipReg --> EDP1
EDP1 --> EDPD{EDP satisfied or no EDP?}
EDPD -->|No| AdvEDP[Advisory: EDP not satisfied]
EDPD -->|Yes| UI1[Check 9: Display trust results and request User approval]
AdvEDP --> UI1
UI1 --> Final{User approves disclosure?}
Final -->|Yes| Present[Present selected attestations]
Final -->|No| Deny2[Deny presentation]
Present --> End([End])
Deny1 --> End
Deny2 --> End
StopAuth --> End
StopBind --> End
StopInt --> End

docs.title: Flowchart to detailed trust-check index
docs.text:
Section Common Presentation Trust Evaluation Model uses coarse step labels (Check 1-Check 9) for control flow. Section Detailed Trust Checks decomposes the same logic into [APTITUDE-RFC003] test-case identifiers (TC-PRES-001-TC-PRES-017). The correspondence is mostly one-to-many: one flowchart label may map to several TC-PRES checks, and some TC-PRES checks have no separate box in the flowchart. Trust-list resolution (TL-PRES-001, Section Trust Anchor and Trusted List Checks) is a cross-cutting dependency of 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:ac9a958da2bd4e1b8bf23aada9762512:, 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:8714d938dde5e5788e5a27df8399eecd:, and 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:0ed145d2b1b2363a76d4c2c42ca8f1ba:<__None__> validation rather than its own flowchart step. Flowchart Trust Checks Notes Check 1 — Authenticate 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:e3d9a5e24910567375032fdd5f8aee51:/RPI using 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:e70579fda7908c976aa0c1b8100e8604: TC-PRES-001 Direct match. U1 — User opted in to RP verification? TC-PRES-002 Same step; not numbered "Check N" in the diagram. Check 2 — Extract authorization evidence TC-PRES-003 Direct match. Check 3A — Validate 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:f453d628f10f71a262b1d30f80ed6fab: TC-PRES-004, TC-PRES-005 One diagram box; Section Detailed Trust Checks splits format/algorithm validation from signature, chain, 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:b0b8249d0503aed8c187f45e3f6a431c:<__None__>, temporal validity, and status. Check 3B — Query and validate Register data TC-PRES-006 Direct match; also used when 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:ebacd8d679b866a557c3d40f2dcd2482: is absent or Check 3A fails. Check 4 — Binding verification TC-PRES-007, TC-PRES-010 TC-PRES-007 covers direct RP binding; TC-PRES-010 (final RP context coherence) is not a separate flowchart box. I1 — Intermediary scenario? TC-PRES-008 Intermediary detection; decision diamond, not a "Check N" label. Check 5 — Verify intermediary association TC-PRES-009 Direct match. Check 6 — Entitlement verification TC-PRES-011 Direct match. Check 7 — Scope comparison TC-PRES-012, TC-PRES-013 Diagram merges attribute extraction and scope comparison. Check 8 — EDP evaluation TC-PRES-014, TC-PRES-015, TC-PRES-016 One diagram box; Section Detailed Trust Checks splits presence, Authorized Relying Parties Only, and Specific Root of Trust. Check 9 — Display trust results and User approval TC-PRES-017 Direct match (implicit in 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:d0934e2aa162b2f02935dbb705806e12: / 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:0a9264768a5216adf0005a2e6ba24304: / 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:fff9d12ebd72c67c3d4c4bf0af6effaf:<__None__> validation) TL-PRES-001 LoTE checks (Section Trust Anchor and Trusted List Checks); no dedicated flowchart node.

Checks in Section Detailed Trust Checks without a Section Common Presentation Trust Evaluation Model "Check N" label: TC-PRES-008 (intermediary detection, see I1), TC-PRES-010 (intermediated RP context coherence, folded into binding in the diagram), TC-PRES-012 (requested-attribute extraction, prerequisite to Check 7).

Flowchart outcomes (not separate trust checks):

Flowchart Node Typical Source Check StopAuth TC-PRES-001 failure AdvNoData TC-PRES-003 / TC-PRES-006 (incomplete evidence or 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:55e04fd2866a093e8d7ed2c977672827:<__None__> validation failed) StopBind TC-PRES-007 / TC-PRES-010 StopInt TC-PRES-009 AdvEnt TC-PRES-011 AdvScope TC-PRES-013 AdvEDP TC-PRES-014 to TC-PRES-016

This is the main artifact the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:1c6a5b66e8caad1b6d4dbbf397d97d74:<__None__> validates before trusting the request. It contains EUDI-specific extensions such as verifier_info. 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:447db380aabf88ddbb938bc0dc2b42b3: chain The 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:502cd8bd582ffe23feaba5eda689b59b: authenticates the technical requester (6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:9dbc05a03a16010ef839f59a608923b6: or Intermediary) that signed the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:f7ee139d24c5ba6adb728972b89cbf12:<__None__>. The certificate chain is carried in the JOSE header using x5c. The 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:54f007648a98719c3719bffc59512db4:<__None__> uses this chain to validate the signer's certificate, check that it chains to a trusted root, and confirm that the request was signed by the entity represented by the access certificate. 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:2d44aeedfc629392ab48193819a8a5e6: The 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:e5e36d7f16806ab1fc55948c24954460: is included by value inside verifier_info. 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:7d3d2a19b2cc54403b184f9e979a37ff: format JWT, typ = rc-wrp+jwt. 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:c4c9a58c3d99324a264a9096143692b0:<__None__> fallback URL / 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:385d04fd9969ac91e8743d82c8c024dd: information Part of verifier_info metadata, under key RPRC_19a. If no usable 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:d8a226558361423103b9172de36310d6: is included, the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:5e964f40bd8e7e405777c588886e547c:<__None__> still needs enough information to identify the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:7395d4b9776b1c3a40e64b59c3684bf6:/service and find the responsible 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:d8ffb0203b41f127324dfd3004659d8c:<__None__>/6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:6fac491bd8ea9731cad5650852d6a5a7:<__None__>. For this reason registrar_url and 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:25ec2657dee9c37172b9929a69c9386f: information are included. Requested attributes DCQL credential_queries[].claims[].

docs.title: Trust checks
docs.text: This section describes how the Trust Evaluation Processes are performed during the Issuance and Presentation flows. For each flow, it specifies which processes are performed, in what order, and by which entity, in order to establish the trust required to complete the operation.

docs.title: Common Presentation Trust Evaluation Model
docs.text:
The authorization logic is common to 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:3027f98aa1871205361ca5fa02e134c0: and 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:bfffcf12152a8f4ca3ab7c0a913e3aa5: flows. The differences are limited to the transport, the location and format of the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:82c1a86b673fe54c98124999b0a8b0e7:, and the way requested attributes are extracted. 

flowchart TD
Start([Presentation request received])
Start --> A1[Check 1: Authenticate WRP/RPI using WRPAC]
A1 --> A1D{WRPAC authentication OK?}
    A1D -->|No| StopAuth[Stop: Authorization Process SHALL NOT start]
A1D -->|Yes| U1{User opted in to RP verification?}
U1 -->|No| SkipReg[Skip registration verification block]
U1 -->|Yes| E1[Check 2: Extract authorization evidence]
E1 --> E2{WRPRC present?}
E2 -->|Yes| W1[Check 3A: Validate WRPRC]
W1 --> W1D{WRPRC valid?}
W1D -->|Yes| B1[Check 4: Binding verification]
W1D -->|No| R1[Check 3B: Query and validate Register data]
E2 -->|No| R1
R1 --> R1D{Register data valid?}
R1D -->|No| AdvNoData[Advisory: RP cannot be fully verified]
R1D -->|Yes| B1
B1 --> B1D{Binding OK?}
B1D -->|No| StopBind[Stop: NOT_AUTHORIZED / binding failure]
B1D -->|Yes| I1{Intermediary scenario?}
I1 -->|Yes| I2[Check 5: Verify intermediary association]
I2 --> I2D{Association OK?}
I2D -->|No| StopInt[Stop: INTERMEDIARY_NOT_AUTHORIZED]
I2D -->|Yes| Ent1[Check 6: Entitlement verification on final RP context]
I1 -->|No| Ent1
Ent1 --> EntD{Service_Provider entitlement present?}
EntD -->|No| AdvEnt[Advisory: wrong entitlement]
EntD -->|Yes| S1[Check 7: Scope comparison]
AdvEnt --> UserReg{User decision on advisory}
AdvNoData --> UserReg
UserReg -->|Deny| Deny1[Deny presentation]
UserReg -->|Proceed| EDP1[Check 8: EDP evaluation]
S1 --> SD{Requested attributes within registered scope?}
SD -->|No| AdvScope[Advisory: over-asking detected]
SD -->|Yes| EDP1
AdvScope --> UserReg
SkipReg --> EDP1
EDP1 --> EDPD{EDP satisfied or no EDP?}
EDPD -->|No| AdvEDP[Advisory: EDP not satisfied]
EDPD -->|Yes| UI1[Check 9: Display trust results and request User approval]
AdvEDP --> UI1
UI1 --> Final{User approves disclosure?}
Final -->|Yes| Present[Present selected attestations]
Final -->|No| Deny2[Deny presentation]
Present --> End([End])
Deny1 --> End
Deny2 --> End
StopAuth --> End
StopBind --> End
StopInt --> End

docs.title: Flowchart to detailed trust-check index
docs.text:
Section Common Presentation Trust Evaluation Model uses coarse step labels (Check 1-Check 9) for control flow. Section Detailed Trust Checks decomposes the same logic into [APTITUDE-RFC003] test-case identifiers (TC-PRES-001-TC-PRES-017). The correspondence is mostly one-to-many: one flowchart label may map to several TC-PRES checks, and some TC-PRES checks have no separate box in the flowchart. Trust-list resolution (TL-PRES-001, Section Trust Anchor and Trusted List Checks) is a cross-cutting dependency of 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:d68d88af71da8974961125afc7c5f9cc:, 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:7490ed2f57c45fe120e3fd555b570d03:, and 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:829d4fc51bdb6e1a6568d72885c3cecc:<__None__> validation rather than its own flowchart step. docs.title: Remote flow trust-check diagram
docs.text:
flowchart LR
RP[Remote RP or RPI] --> Req[Signed OpenID4VP Request Object]
Req --> WRPAC[Check: WRPAC chain in x5c]
Req --> WRPRC[Check: WRPRC from verifier_info]
Req --> RPRC19a[Check: RPRC_19a data / registry URI]

Eval --> User[Display results to User]

Item Proximity Flow Source Signed request artifact The reader sends a DeviceRequest, which contains one or more document requests. Requested attributes docRequest.itemRequest.nameSpaces.

Warning

The current trust specification notes that the mapping of RPRC_19a data in requestInfo is not fully defined in [ETSI TS 119 472-2]. [APTITUDE-RFC003] SHOULD either define an APTITUDE convention for this mapping or mark the related tests as dependent on the final ETSI / APTITUDE profile decision.

docs.title: Trust evaluation
docs.text:
This section describes the Core Trust Evaluation Processes, which establish trust between two interacting entities by verifying their identities against a recognized 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:46fcfbe5e6543e1397d3dd3277b5c192:<__None__> and confirming their eligibility to perform a given operation (e.g., issuing or requesting an 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:2e0dbc403de13ebad67cd04162f65250:<__None__> of a specific type). These processes are as follows:

  • Trust Anchor Validation Process;
  • Sign/Seal Validation Process;
  • Authentication Process;
  • Authorization Process.

The X.509 Certificate Chain Validation process is shared across the Sign/Seal Validation Process, the Authentication Process, and the Authorization Process. It validates a certificate path against the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:c6f65a2b44e505471644a11c59870664:<__None__> obtained from a validated 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:43bd39cd8d4ce86f0c7303eaee11115a: or 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:872749caf4806bef929f2f61dbde8666:.

docs.title: Trust Anchor Validation Process
docs.text:
The Trust Anchor Validation Process establishes the cryptographic integrity and authenticity of 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:96d008de77462b2184a99fd79a621e69:, which are the authoritative sources for 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:c463458ba5ce0e64d723853e28b144ca:. A 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:340504b04bd4dd3dfbccbb59d2e97806:<__None__> is an X.509 certificate containing the name and public key used by a 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:1650c82729f27631c6bfc4e468f0d04c:<__None__> or 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:0ff31ce4d4a1964d6c4f5c6eb5b5b50f: to validate an artifact or 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:ea2afdbe3b065aafb807b0e62baf0ca3:<__None__>.

Choice

Within the APTITUDE ecosystem, all trust anchors SHALL be obtained from the applicable dedicated 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:6df347b771505e0e9cc67bfdbe9b523b:. This applies to 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:d332d9739b436d092125208ab1333588:, 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:9c7d958fd138f32566b2b6e14ed4d6d3:, 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:dbf037d5ed21e79ff9c358d00ee030e6:, 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:c06a0306d62c29ff62d0265f73bced85:, 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:7f1b9e91fe8473c47ebe56a22d358a5b:, 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:058de92b187099ad8629c03c4bdef49d:, 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:a9c5f3b85220d943dc2c7824b30f3bb0:, 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:59d77967ef20ec8e35c55a9970ec661c: and their 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:f7e39694cd464f714b90ee660fb890eb:.

Depending on the artifact or 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:71fe004920122f3521aa3ff78a80d63f:<__None__> being verified, the validating entity SHALL fetch, download, and validate the dedicated 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:7d3027d003993b1253ca32eb681f3ea3: for the required entity type. The 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:3fc0eeedb7755d60bd9d81365ac5670d: is used to retrieve 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:bc1fd5fed716bd29011f60db0176f4fb: for validating:

  1. Infrastructure Certificates: 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:27eed6c97cfb07cc625e16fb253b360e: and 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:9c928b9a39ce1daa407b0f4f0cc978c6:.
  2. 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:81fa757095b538e876659ba4ec8af3fc:: 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:7eb65f5ac27c448e936ac26572c0b290:<__None__> and 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:aec788181f683e26b1b7826dfc9091e3:<__None__>.
  3. 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:9048fe082343ac93760b4b7257fe5c12: Signatures: 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:8104471e5490a5a84c6dd7a3a9b10e4f:<__None__>.
  4. 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:0701af7cb0f0638057a9bf139e0c9fa9:<__None__> Signatures and Seals: 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:d6471ef7897b375a615356248e8d88ae:, 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:4fb0e0e6e60c49e577ba847af56022fd:, and 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:f2448fe776881ac86270744d6527059b:.
  5. Artifacts and 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:9025bd95b87a8f08f6fda8ce1efd590d:<__None__> Status and Revocation Information: 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:c7ce24e53e621605ffd2d96b6a2a1fa4:<__None__> for 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:a61793354bd93520e1ec9e1dd07d0b54:, 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:9d8540419697d13896cb5c21dd4194c1:, 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:844ebe69617c3094266c54b6c7bdea68:, and 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:b15b39f4f9a2085c0f08474934fe05a9: status information; 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:218fac514efc02c217da76895b7f01b1: or 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:b91574324adf8715fcf65c125f2b62be: for 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:b075247be2f1f2f4b2cd09c5105bf0d6: and Sign/Seal Certificate status information.
  6. Registrar-signed Artifacts: 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:2c418756f8e3aadb5d00f47f235ec573:<__None__> information.

    7. Choice

    Within the APTITUDE ecosystem, the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:c66827a31cbd70dd509196a28c0d28b0: for 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:c2e9c153a03fa708bee869816aab1a62: and 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:78b2040c3cc3a3383b2dda212969a809: SHALL be retrieved from and validated against their dedicated 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:b1b4c1250ed28a55d06fc2335933d998:. The same 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:3434baa3129ff7cac02fcaa7a12ec0c1: validation process SHALL be used for these 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:911b58cc9ec7937afe2d42a16812c10d: as for all other APTITUDE entities.

    To verify the authenticity of a retrieved 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:71370dc9db9b0ca69c0e97f5a6654b48:, the validating entity SHALL:

    • obtain the location and authorized signing certificate set for the requested 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:2862725640fb1e5db54825eb45fd2d5d: type from the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:738cf1989266f8b43440f3333206dee8:<__None__>;
    • verify the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:8d8b2acd312781dfe9bb5ac40720999e: signature or seal using the format-specific procedure and bind the signer to the certificate set published in the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:90ed1c2126179573f0e32bd082aeaba4:;
    • validate the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:79ec6e9be4e61390b36c24bfcfcc55b5: structure, requested 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:0e16d08b059d85aade4e5750a4e89eae: type, freshness, and any authenticated pivot history.

docs.title: List of Trusted Entities Validation
docs.text:
This section defines the validation of a 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:3ee5e653e88e221e3f098b202c9177f6:. The 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:715e17180a62afaee1429fc50c05769c: format is specified in List of Trusted Entities.

Before validating a 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:e88d6b79cc60c140eac498f627401a28:, the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:529ecdbabfab974e570e4170c7ba9d0b:<__None__> or 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:6f0ad609759c7f944552a56b48fd9124: SHALL select the required 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:b6f76dfd8281290dfad4b366ed60909f: type and obtain its type-specific location and authorized signing certificate set from the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:454ceaefdb2d7ca429541febf5156932:. The 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:e8cb4186e8226714e29b1e9ca6a0fcdc: SHALL be downloaded from the location published for that type.

docs.title: List of Trusted Entities Retrieval and Validation Sequence Diagram
docs.text:
sequenceDiagram
  participant Client as Wallet/WRP
  participant OJA as Official Journal of APTITUDE
  participant Distribution as LoTE Distribution Point

  Client->>OJA: Request discovery for required LoTE type
  OJA-->>Client: Return type-specific location and signer certificates
  Client->>Distribution: Request LoTE at OJA-published location
  Distribution-->>Client: Return JSON/JWT or XML/XAdES LoTE
  Client->>Client: Verify format-specific signature and OJA binding
  Client->>Client: Validate schema and requested LoTE type
  Client->>Client: Discover and validate authenticated pivots
  Client->>Client: Extract trust anchors for target entity

docs.title: List of Trusted Entities Validation Process
docs.text:
The validator initializes the following variables:

Input Variables:

  • Requested-LoTE-Type: The 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:8254d89ab4df547976adfc69579915e5: type required for the artifact or 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:25fddab915c2fbce6e69c0bb632bf305:<__None__> being validated.
  • OJA-Loc: URI of the latest known 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:a7bfe1bb7a8fe028600e3ba698eec63c: publication for the requested LoTE type.
  • OJA-LoTE-Loc: URI of the last processed 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:4aa3dd9ab3bc2416d4ac3a97213f39ab: instance for the requested type. It is initialized to the location published in the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:d416e203a2678a47cbc76252f5492c94:.
  • OJA-LoTE-Certs-Set: The set of certificates authorized by the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:26bafe2f3405d193f2a2a755f31f306a: to verify the requested 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:29435f3a4a77b52aa370e2a88e511cae: type.
  • LoTE: The JSON/JWT or XML/XAdES 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:6245e7e90decc9db20240f9b11217313: currently being processed. Initialized as NULL.
  • LoTE-Format: The format of LoTE, either JSON or XML.
  • LoTE-Signer-Cert: The certificate used to verify the signature or seal on LoTE. Initialized as NULL.
  • LoTESO-Cert: The signer certificate of the current 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:f4d39641adeaad0d083877722a63eeda: or pivot. Initialized as NULL.
  • LoTESO-Certs-Set: Certificates authorized by an authenticated PointersToOtherLoTE entry for the next pivot. Initialized as NULL.

    • Output Variables:

    • Authenticated-LoTE: The validated 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:a1d1a5b90b87b985d699e681c0b0f010: payload.
    • LoTE-Status: The validation result, for example LoTE_VERIFICATION_PASSED.
    • LoTE-Sub-Status: Detailed error codes supplementing LoTE-Status.

docs.title: JSON LoTE Signature Verification and OJA Binding
docs.text:
This procedure applies when the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:1bbe4ded0765b1c4d1e884afdab3f0d7: is JSON formatted and uses the Compact JAdES Baseline B profile. In the APTITUDE profile, x5t#S256 is the selected certificate-reference implementation choice for this format. A Compact JAdES signature is a compact JWS; when the JWT representation is selected, the decoded payload SHALL contain the private LoTE claim defined in the Compact JAdES profile.

The validator SHALL perform the following operations before using any payload value for pivot discovery or trust-anchor extraction:

  1. Parse the JWS Compact Serialization into its protected header, payload, and signature parts. The protected header SHALL contain alg, iat, and x5t#S256; an algorithm value of none SHALL be rejected.
  2. Decode x5t#S256 from Base64url and compute the SHA-256 digest of the DER encoding of each certificate in the authorized certificate set. Exactly one certificate in OJA-LoTE-Certs-Set SHALL match the value. Set that certificate as LoTE-Signer-Cert.
  3. Verify the JWS signature over the JWS Signing Input using the public key in LoTE-Signer-Cert.
  4. Decode the payload. If the JWT representation is selected, require the private LoTE claim. Validate the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:06b4954e1f8ab4a5f63e137a14487ef0: object against LoTE_Payload_Json_schema.yaml; otherwise validate the JSON payload against the applicable JSON 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:77d02fd8edc0f0ca55fa3a2f2fe4a867: schema.
  5. Confirm that the LoTEType in the authenticated payload equals Requested-LoTE-Type and that the DistributionPoints value is the endpoint published by the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:7f848ae51260b0102854e0d6d1f88ffb: for that type.

    If any operation fails, validation SHALL stop with LoTE-Status set to LoTE_VERIFICATION_FAILED and the applicable signature, certificate-binding, format, or type sub-status.

docs.title: XML LoTE Signature Verification and OJA Binding
docs.text:
This procedure applies when the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:d6a1f4eefdbf71a28bec061104eb24ce: is XML formatted and uses XAdES Baseline B. XAdES Baseline B is specified by [ETSI EN 319 132-1]; [ETSI EN 319 132-2] defines extended XAdES signatures and is not the governing specification for the Baseline B profile.

The validator SHALL perform the following operations before using any 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:9f37203f61f63244fd20a9c21749a5aa: value for pivot discovery or 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:ddff783b5df23a36f6c115342b972f69:<__None__> extraction:

  1. Validate the XML document against the applicable 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:05ab766bbc5acecc16ca5d9648cd493e: XML schema and locate the enveloped ds:Signature and its xades:QualifyingProperties.
  2. Validate the XML signature references, including the reference to the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:8fcb78f1e4abf6418ff52bbec3ed36e8: document with URI="", the enveloped-signature transform, and exclusive XML canonicalization. Validate the reference to xades:SignedProperties with Type="http://uri.etsi.org/01903#SignedProperties".
  3. Extract the signing certificate from ds:KeyInfo/ds:X509Data/ds:X509Certificate. The first xades:SigningCertificateV2/xades:Cert SHALL contain the digest of the DER encoding of this certificate. The digest SHALL use SHA-256 and the DigestValue SHALL use the XML signature Base64 encoding.
  4. Compare the extracted certificate, by exact DER certificate identity, with the certificates in OJA-LoTE-Certs-Set. Set the matching certificate as LoTE-Signer-Cert.
  5. Verify the XML signature using LoTE-Signer-Cert, including the signed properties and all signed 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:86a738bf04b01d895c82231c50a9e4ba: data objects.
  6. Confirm that the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:af0cc58be672d431fff32c9498846490: type in the authenticated XML document equals Requested-LoTE-Type and that its distribution point is the endpoint published by the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:47690c2bc9b6a738e06eeea5942d009c: for that type.

    If any operation fails, validation SHALL stop with LoTE-Status set to LoTE_VERIFICATION_FAILED and the applicable signature, certificate-binding, format, or type sub-status. XAdES SigningCertificateV2 is not by itself a 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:bf6a2ba4698e2ae75ecbc4a35ae6beff:<__None__>; the exact certificate match to the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:3f6f7433b9c99625a61b075e6fcf9b45: certificate set is required.

docs.title: LoTE Validation Operations
docs.text:
The validation SHALL perform the following steps:

  1. Initialization. Select the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:a38c3158a69774b92c16f03a99fc3010: record for Requested-LoTE-Type, download the JSON/JWT or XML/XAdES file from OJA-LoTE-Loc, and assign it to LoTE.
  2. Parsing. Set LoTE-Format to JSON or XML. For JSON, resolve LoTE-Signer-Cert by matching the protected x5t#S256 value against the DER SHA-256 digests of the certificates in OJA-LoTE-Certs-Set. For XML, extract the signing certificate from ds:KeyInfo/ds:X509Data/ds:X509Certificate and match its xades:SigningCertificateV2 DER digest against OJA-LoTE-Certs-Set.
  3. Pivot Discovery. Iterate through the uriValue claims in the SchemeInformationURI object. Count the number of valid URIs found before encountering the URI matching OJA-Loc. Let \(n\) be that count.
    • If no URI matches OJA-Loc: Validation SHALL fail with LoTE-Status set to LoTE_VERIFICATION_FAILED and LoTE-Sub-Status set to OJA_LOCATION_INPUT_NOT_MATCHING_OJA_LOCATION_IN_LoTE. This implies a 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:243e60ce06a96aab91850ccdf9349268:<__None__> migration is required.
  4. 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:5cd626a4d7822aefd189c29e1d3ed7df: Location Conflict. Check the condition: OJA-LoTE-Loc != LoTELocation AND LoTE != Content at LoTELocation.
    • (LoTELocation is the URI in the PointersToOtherLoTE claim of LoTE with SchemeTerritory = EU).
    • If TRUE: Validation SHALL stop with LoTE-Status set to LoTE_VERIFICATION_FAILED and LoTE-Sub-Status set to LoTE_FILE_CONFLICT.
    • If FALSE, proceed to the next step.
  5. 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:c489fc9641bf7c1e3671421cb6c33bf1: Freshness. Check the condition: OJA-LoTE-Loc == LoTELocation AND LoTE != Content at LoTELocation.
    • If TRUE: Set OJA-LoTE-Loc to LoTELocation and restart from Step 1.
    • If FALSE, proceed to the next step.
  6. Digital Signature Validation. Validate the cryptographic signature of the current LoTE using the format-specific Compact JAdES or XAdES Baseline B procedure and the public key from LoTE-Signer-Cert.
    • If validation fails: Stop with LoTE-Status set to LoTE_VERIFICATION_FAILED and LoTE-Sub-Status set to LoTE_SIGNATURE_VERIFICATION_FAILED.
    • If successful:
      • Set LoTESO-Cert to LoTE-Signer-Cert.
      • Set LoTESO-Certs-Set to the certificates found in the PointersToOtherLoTE claim (territory EU) of the current LoTE payload.
  7. Intermediate Pivot Validation.
    • Case \(n=0\) (No Pivots): Proceed directly to Step 8.
    • Case \(n>0\) (History Chain):
      • Iterate \(i\) from 1 to \(n\) (from most recent Pivot to oldest). Let Pivot be the file downloaded from the \(i\)-th URI.
      • Link Check. Set Pivot-Certs-Set to the certificates in the PointersToOtherLoTE claim (territory EU) of Pivot. If LoTESO-Cert (the signer of the previous file in the chain) is not in Pivot-Certs-Set, validation SHALL fail with LoTE-Sub-Status set to PIVOT_i-1_SIGNER_CERT_NOT_AUTHENTICATED_BY_PIVOT_i.
      • Update Signer. For JSON Pivot, resolve LoTESO-Cert by matching its protected x5t#S256 value against Pivot-Certs-Set. For XML Pivot, extract the signing certificate from ds:KeyInfo/ds:X509Data/ds:X509Certificate and match its xades:SigningCertificateV2 DER digest against Pivot-Certs-Set.
      • Verify Signature. Validate the signature of Pivot using the applicable Compact JAdES or XAdES Baseline B procedure and LoTESO-Cert. If it fails, validation SHALL fail with LoTE-Status set to LoTE_VERIFICATION_FAILED, and LoTE-Sub-Status set to PIVOT_i_SIGNATURE_VERIFICATION_FAILED.
      • The loop continues, walking backwards until LoTESO-Cert represents the signer of the oldest Pivot.
  8. 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:6475c82d78cea697becf13526d73b01b:<__None__> Validation. Verify the end of the chain. If LoTESO-Cert (from the last Pivot or current 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:1371afdd110a57a3b72b1dca8787cb20:) is not in OJA-LoTE-Certs-Set (the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:088866078cb13b4f093634ad70990942:<__None__>), validation SHALL fail with LoTE-Sub-Status set to PIVOT_n_SIGNER_CERT_NOT_AUTHENTICATED_BY_OJA.
  9. Expiration. If current time > NextUpdate claim of LoTE, validation SHALL fail.
  10. Success. Set Authenticated-LoTE to LoTE, LoTE-Status to LoTE_VERIFICATION_PASSED, and LoTE-Sub-Status to an empty list.
  11. Update Bookmark. If OJA-LoTE-Loc does not match the LoTELocation in Authenticated-LoTE (territory EU), update OJA-LoTE-Loc to that value.
  12. Update Anchor. [Caution: This step modifies the Root of Trust configuration]
    • If OJA-Loc does not match the first URI in SchemeInformationURI, update OJA-LoTE-Loc.
    • Update OJA-LoTE-Certs-Set according to the new 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:8ff2d26452c4061f01f4053516db7ff0:<__None__> from a new 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:0656a77acf40aebee5be119bbecc25f7: publication for the requested 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:d587ba839d39550cdf41dc0672dd4b7f: type.

      Warning

      The 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:ea7f5a45b0e311171262fc66d2f815c0: validation process is mutuated from the [ETSI TS 119 615] standard, and adapted to the APTITUDE profiles context.

      Remarks

      • The 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:5d7a92d4bf7fcc722d54706945868950: record is type-specific: a validator SHALL NOT use the endpoint or certificate set published for one 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:250a6a36fff408dbcf09a3a08324f93c: type to validate another 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:277406313a7d4a955756eafd87f32d84: type.
      • The JSON x5t#S256 value binds the JWS signer to an 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:dfcdaa7defa3d68d8ce1b1f526feb6fc:-published certificate by the SHA-256 digest of its DER encoding. The XML SigningCertificateV2 value provides the corresponding XAdES certificate digest, and the validator additionally performs exact certificate matching against the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:04bf81616869bbf12f0e42dbb238acd5: certificate set.
      • Payload fields are not trusted for pivot discovery, distribution-point changes, or 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:b155685ebf0dfba1dfcb326f9fa07d2f:<__None__> extraction until the format-specific signature and 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:1bea34e6843205211f75ac9feaa71bd2: certificate binding have succeeded.
      • A cached 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:cb57167742cf8b7f02931978f8c37f24: and its 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:cb0938bebdc1c3880ed8fa962f6867e9:-authorized signer certificate MAY be reused only within the caching rules specified in the LoTE profile; the cache SHALL be refreshed no later than NextUpdate and when the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:ba6023cd79c09771a3d0bfeca8f1969b: record changes.

        Below is a flowchart summarizing the validation of a 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:30c0e636591e9fabda9426cbcfceef7e:: 

        flowchart TD
    classDef failure fill:#f8d7da,stroke:#721c24,color:#721c24,font-weight:bold;
    classDef success fill:#d4edda,stroke:#155724,color:#155724,font-weight:bold;
    classDef warning fill:#fff3cd,stroke:#856404,color:#856404;
    classDef process fill:#fff,stroke:#333,stroke-width:1px;
    classDef decision fill:#e7f3fe,stroke:#0056b3,stroke-width:1px;

    Start([Start LoTE JWT Validation]) --> Init[1. Init & Download LoTE<br/>from OJA-LoTE-Loc]:::process
    Init --> Parse[2. Parse Header:<br/>Extract Signer Cert x5c]:::process

    %% Step 3: Pivot Discovery
    Parse --> S3{3. Found OJA-Loc URI in history?}:::decision
    S3 -- "No (NotFound)" --> F3[Fail: OJA Loc Not Found<br/>Trust Anchor Migration Needed]:::failure

    %% Steps 4 & 5: Location & Freshness Checks
    S3 -- "Yes (Set n)" --> S4{4. Location Conflict?<br/>Old-LoTE-Loc != New-LoTE-Loc AND <br/> Old-LoTE != New-LoTE}:::decision
    S4 -- Yes --> F4[Fail: File Conflict / Spoofing]:::failure
    S4 -- No --> S5{5. Freshness Check<br/>Old-LoTE-Loc == New-LoTE-Loc AND <br/> Old-LoTE != New-LoTE}:::decision
    S5 -- "Yes (New Version Detected)" --> UpdateLoc[Update OJA-LoTE-Loc]:::warning
    UpdateLoc --> Init
    S5 -- "No (Current is Fresh)" --> S6

    %% Step 6: Signature & Setup
    S6{6. Validate current LoTE Signature}:::decision
    S6 -- Invalid --> F6[Fail: LoTE Sig Verification Failed]:::failure
    S6 -- Valid --> SetupVars[Set Variables:<br/>Current Signer = LoTE-Signer-Cert<br/>Extract Trusted Set from Payload]:::process

    %% Step 7: The Loop
    SetupVars --> S7Check{"7. Is n = 0 (no Pivots)?"}:::decision
    S7Check -- Yes --> S8
    S7Check -- "No (n > 0, Start Loop)" --> LoopStart[Start Pivot Loop i=1 to n]:::process

    subgraph Pivot Validation Chain
        LoopStart --> DownloadPivot[Download Pivot i]:::process
        DownloadPivot --> LinkCheck{Link Check:<br/>Is Current Signer trusted by Pivot i payload?}:::decision
        LinkCheck -- No --> FLink[Fail: Broken Trust Chain]:::failure
        LinkCheck -- Yes --> UpdateSigner[Update Current Signer:<br/>Extract Signer from Pivot i Header]:::process
        UpdateSigner --> SigCheckPivot{Validate Pivot i Signature}:::decision
        SigCheckPivot -- Invalid --> FSigPivot[Fail: Pivot Sig Invalid]:::failure
        SigCheckPivot -- Valid --> LoopNext{i < n ?<br/>More Pivots?}:::decision
    end

    LoopNext -- "Yes (i++)" --> DownloadPivot
    LoopNext -- No --> S8

    %% Step 8: Trust Anchor Validation
    S8{8. Trust Anchor Validation:<br/>Is Final Signer in OJA-LoTE-Certs-Set?}:::decision
    S8 -- No --> F8[Fail: Not authenticated by OJA]:::failure

    %% Step 9: Expiration
    S8 -- Yes --> S9{9. Expiration Check:<br/>Now > NextUpdate?}:::decision
    S9 -- Yes --> F9[Fail: LoTE Expired]:::failure

    %% Step 10: Success
    S9 -- No --> Success[10. Validation PASSED]:::success

    %% Steps 11 & 12: Updates
    Success --> UpdateBM[11. Update Local Bookmark OJA-LoTE-Loc<br/>if changed in payload]:::process
    UpdateBM --> UpdateTA[12. Update Trust Anchor Config]:::warning
    UpdateTA --> End([End Process])

    %% Consolidation of failure endpoints
    F3 --> EndFail([Stop: Validation FAILED]):::failure
    F4 --> EndFail
    F6 --> EndFail
    FLink --> EndFail
    FSigPivot --> EndFail
    F8 --> EndFail
    F9 --> EndFail

      Where authoritative sources conflict with non-authoritative sources, the authoritative sources SHALL supersede [AUTHZ-IN-07]. Where the authenticated 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:f06f7bf6dd37d6971d2385acf3ed8cc6: context conflicts with the identity or intermediary binding in the verified authorization context, the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:fac84b5c50a77b0771765d08ad719662:<__None__> SHALL produce NOT_AUTHORIZED (non-overridable) [AUTHZ-IN-08].

      A request-carried 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:bd0b5615d26c24a5bd2f18778f1e01c9:<__None__> URL SHALL NOT be treated as sufficient proof of registered information by itself; it MAY be used only as a discovery hint unless confirmed by an authoritative source [AUTHZ-IN-09].

docs.title: Decision Model
docs.text:
The 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:99843040cb6803229b4fc366f1a74c2e:<__None__> SHALL provide an authorization decision expressed as AUTHORIZED or NOT_AUTHORIZED [AUTHZ-UI-01].

Each evaluation procedure (defined later in this section) gives a granular verification result code when it detects a negative condition. These codes feed into the final decision and into the advisories presented to the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:97fc4911be388a683a311368731a01c3:<__None__>.

| Code | Phase | Meaning | | --------------------------------- | :-----------: | ------------- | | CERTIFICATE_INVALID | Both | 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:20f37fb0996fa5f7ef3c8e68ee6ca4ad: validation failed. | | FAILED | Both | Registration data could not be obtained or verified. | | WRONG_ENTITLEMENT | Both | Entity entitlement does not match expected role. | | ATTESTATION_TYPE_NOT_REGISTERED | Issuance | Requested 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:267cbb7fd344a361c3edc4c6d5c76a4b:<__None__> is not in registered list. | | BINDING_FAILED | Both | Authorization subject does not match authenticated identity. | | INTERMEDIARY_NOT_AUTHORIZED | Presentation | 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:d23344f8c70b237f58eb17c0b2333035: association verification failed. | | VERIFICATION_PASSED | Presentation | All requested attributes are registered. | | OVERASKING_DETECTED | Presentation | Some requested attributes are not registered. | | EDP_SATISFIED | Presentation | 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:6b766e5147aae62762b1be839b4c2fe1: conditions met. | | EDP_NOT_SATISFIED | Presentation | 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:61f4b60ea6d2d5417ed737a7457109fc: conditions not met. |

The Authorization Process SHALL support transparent decision-making and SHALL NOT be a purely hidden backend check [AUTHZ-UI-05].

docs.title: Override Principles
docs.text:
A NOT_AUTHORIZED decision MAY be either non-overridable (the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:8b1aabf815c4d2efa4061222822a4d56:<__None__> blocks the interaction) or overridable (the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:3afc9551fe4bd9f76f5d02408af44833:<__None__> presents the negative outcome and the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:6e509fdf42ee8a0b954542c1cc05117e:<__None__> MAY choose to proceed).

In issuance phase, all negative verification outcomes SHALL NOT be overridable: the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:59072e8bef1ebf7296f93ae559b2056c:<__None__> protects the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:24532bac7576dcf57bd7ccec63ceb3c8:<__None__> from providers whose registration cannot be confirmed (per ISSU_24a, ISSU_34a, ISSU_34b).

In presentation phase, two specific cases are overridable:

  1. Negative scope comparison (per RPRC_21: the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:37c1488284f3a3ed002df301fc4e64f6:<__None__> is informed of unregistered attributes but can proceed).
  2. Negative 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:5906fff926da4404eba819d84f70add4: evaluation (per EDP_07: the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:7dc196dd179857c6edc9a57a9e7b30f7:<__None__> can deny or allow).

    All other presentation failures (binding failures and intermediary binding failures) are non-overridable because they indicate an integrity problem rather than a user-facing choice.

    In case of non-overridable failures, the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:1ffd127e6736c6cbdc40e791044fc769:<__None__> SHALL clearly inform the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:77edd28817a4f9444aaafad38df629cc:<__None__> about the negative outcome. User-relevant information about overridable outcomes SHALL be presented as advisories, and the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:1775a24a8a870a2afdd9c3ee6da20da2:<__None__> approval SHALL be a separate step from the authorization decision [AUTHZ-UI-02, AUTHZ-UI-03, AUTHZ-UI-04].

    User Opt-In

    The 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:b5f963b824b46e91e786089837f9027d: Validation Procedure is mandatory. The Scope Comparison Procedure is executed only if the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:2e03bc33401b615223fd610ad7c7c624:<__None__> enabled scope comparison (RPRC_16). Override mechanisms define what happens when the procedure produces a negative result.

    The detailed override rules are provided in the Override Rules section.

docs.title: Authorization Evidences
docs.text: This section describes the data objects that carry authorization information such as where they originate, how they are distributed, and what parameters are relevant for authorization decisions. The evaluation procedures that operate on these data objects are defined in the section Evaluation Procedures.

docs.title: Evaluation Procedures
docs.text: This section defines the individual verification procedures that are composed into end-to-end flows in the Operational Flows section. Each procedure is self-contained: it specifies its inputs, its processing logic, and its output (a verification result code). The override behaviour for each procedure's negative outcome is detailed in the Override Rules section.

docs.title: WRPRC Validation Procedure
docs.text:
The 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:3c8a2ac6df474db3ffe26b2841320d49:<__None__> SHALL validate the issued 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:d12f666984a4b3782be5f6098cb6f459: before relying on it [AUTHZ-GEN-08]. If the issued 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:9954e66ec9a31e12350c8f183cc41126: is absent, the mandatory check fails with CERTIFICATE_INVALID.

The validation procedure is:

  1. Format Verification: confirm typ is rc-wrp+jwt (remote) or rc-wrp+cwt (proximity) ([ETSI TS 119 475, Section 5.2.1]).
  2. Algorithm Verification: verify the conformance of signature algorithm (neither "none" nor deprecated).
  3. Signature and Certificate Chain Validation: verify the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:72f9e916c8d69e43cfa8c7ae912f7eb9: signature and validate the chain.
  4. 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:93b37288b0925ede7e486df2f57156cc:<__None__> Resolution: fetch the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:05cbd2e2a2c0ab70ce62d3f5b26f574b:<__None__> for the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:b63616f6b0b52dd43e0c803601a897f0: from the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:985b061d9ba404d1e3c60a95153bdf07:. The 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:5e2d09a898e417da7d7e6686a4f40084:<__None__> SHALL accept 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:145fb2f313b2f3f2272140f65da5cfa1: from all 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:6092a2fee3c8befb603d29c3dc445d73: 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:646f30ae48dfec57b7ea5fe736281af5: (ISSU_33a).
  5. Temporal Validity: check iat and exp (if present).

docs.title: Operational Flows
docs.text: This section combines the evaluation procedures defined above into end-to-end flows for issuance and presentation.

docs.title: Interaction Flow
docs.text:
sequenceDiagram
    %%autonumber
    participant User
    participant WI as Wallet Instance
    participant AP as Attestation Provider
    participant TL as WRPRC LoTE
    participant Reg as Register

    User->>WI: 1. Request issuance
    WI->>AP: 2. Fetch Credential Issuer Metadata (OpenID4VCI)
    AP-->>WI: 3. Signed Credential Issuer Metadata

    Note over WI: 4. Verify metadata signature (WRPAC)

    alt Valid WRPRC in issuer_info (format "registration_cert")
        Note over WI: 5a. Extract WRPRC
        WI->>TL: 6a. Fetch trust anchor
        TL-->>WI: 7a. Trust anchor
        Note over WI: 8a. WRPRC Validation Procedure
    else invalid WRPRC
        opt Register backup check
            Note over WI: 5b. Extract registryURI from registrar_dataset
            WI->>Reg: 6b. Query registration data
            Reg-->>WI: 7b. Registration data
            Note over WI: 8b. Register Validation Procedure
        end
    end

    Note over WI: 9. Binding Verification Procedure
    Note over WI: 10. Entitlement Verification Procedure
    Note over WI: 11. Attestation Type Verification Procedure

    alt All verifications passed
        WI->>User: 12a. Show provider info, request confirmation
        User-->>WI: 13. User confirms
        Note over WI: 14. Store EDP if present
        WI->>AP: 15. Proceed with issuance
    else Verification failed
        WI->>User: 12b. Display warning, block issuance
    end

docs.title: Combined Mechanisms Flowchart
docs.text:
flowchart TD
    Start([Presentation request received]) --> ObtainData[Mandatory WRPRC validation]

    ObtainData --> DataOK{WRPRC check<br/>passed?}
    DataOK -->|No| RegisterChoice{Use Register<br/>check?}
    RegisterChoice -->|Yes| RegisterData[Query Register]
    RegisterChoice -->|No| WarnNoData[Advisory: cannot verify RP]
    RegisterData --> RegisterOK{Register<br/>check passed?}
    RegisterOK -->|No| WarnNoData
    RegisterOK -->|Yes| Binding[Binding Verification]
    DataOK -->|Yes| Binding

    Binding --> BindOK{Binding<br/>OK?}
    BindOK -->|No| BlockBinding[NOT_AUTHORIZED]
    BindOK -->|Yes| Entitlement[Entitlement Verification]

    Entitlement --> EntOK{Entitlement<br/>OK?}
    EntOK -->|No| WarnEnt[Advisory: wrong entitlement]
    EntOK -->|Yes| UserOptIn{User opted-in<br/>to scope comparison?}
    UserOptIn -->|Yes| Scope[Scope Comparison]
    UserOptIn -->|No| RegPassed[Registration checks complete]

    Scope --> ScopeOK{All attributes<br/>registered?}
    ScopeOK -->|Yes| RegPassed
    ScopeOK -->|No| WarnScope[Advisory: unregistered attributes]

    WarnNoData --> |Deny| Deny
    WarnEnt --> UserReg{User decision}
    WarnScope --> UserReg

    UserReg -->|Deny| Deny[Deny presentation]
    UserReg -->|Proceed| RegWarning[Proceed with warning]

    RegPassed --> EDP
    RegWarning --> EDP

    EDP[EDP Evaluation<br/>for each Attestation]
    EDP --> HasEDP{Has EDP?}
    HasEDP -->|No| Allow[Allow Attestation]
    HasEDP -->|Yes| EvalEDP[Evaluate policy]

    EvalEDP --> EDPOk{Satisfied?}
    EDPOk -->|Yes| Allow
    EDPOk -->|No| Flag[Flag with advisory]

    Allow --> More{More<br/>Attestations?}
    Flag --> More
    More -->|Yes| HasEDP
    More -->|No| Approval[Show results + advisories<br/>Request User approval]

    Approval --> Final{User decision}
    Final -->|Approve| Present[Present Attestations]
    Final -->|Deny| Deny

    Present --> End([End])
    Deny --> End
    BlockBinding --> End

    style WarnNoData fill:#ffffcc
    style WarnEnt fill:#ffffcc
